english: Saimaa is a large lake system in southeastern Finland, divided by islands and narrow channels into many named basins. Its waters drain by the Vuoksi River toward Lake Ladoga. The waterways also formed part of a contested frontier between Sweden and the Russian lands. In 1475 Erik Axelsson Tott founded Olavinlinna, or St Olaf's Castle, on an island between the Haukivesi and Pihlajavesi basins. The surrounding lakes impeded a potential attack, while trade grew around the stronghold and the town of Savonlinna received its charter in 1639. After wars between Sweden and Russia, the Treaty of Åbo in 1743 ceded the castle and its region to Russia. The lake's channels and islands thus shaped both movement and defence in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 塞马湖是芬兰东南部广阔的湖泊水系，岛屿与狭窄水道将其分成许多各有名称的湖盆，湖水经武奥克西河流向拉多加湖。这里的水道也处于瑞典与俄罗斯诸地争夺的边疆。1475年，埃里克·阿克塞尔松·托特在豪基韦西与皮赫拉亚韦西之间的岛上修建奥拉维城堡，又称圣奥拉夫堡。周围湖泊能够阻碍进攻，城堡附近逐渐发展贸易，萨翁林纳于1639年获得城市特许。瑞典与俄国战争之后，1743年的《奥布和约》将城堡及周围地区割让给俄国。湖泊的水道和岛屿因而同时影响了地方交通与防御。

english: Sain, also known as Sain Qaleh, lies on the Zarrineh River south of Lake Urmia. The river descends from the Kurdish mountains through a series of valleys before reaching the lake's southern plain. Fields and orchards follow its course between the upland ridges, and the settlement occupies a route linking the basin around Miandoab with the mountain country toward Saqqez.
simp_chinese: 萨因又称萨因堡，位于乌尔米耶湖以南的扎里内河畔。河流从库尔德山区穿过一连串谷地，流向湖泊南面的平原。田地和果园沿河分布在高地山脊之间，聚落则坐落在连接米扬多阿布盆地与萨盖兹方向山区的道路上。

english: Sainápuchi, also recorded as Sainapos, was a Tarahumara settlement in the uplands west of Chihuahua. In 1694 it was listed as a visita, or dependent mission village, of Santa Isabel, on a route that also passed through San Andrés. Missionary work there had only recently begun, and the village was reported to contain forty Indigenous families. It later came under the mission of San Andrés, part of the network of Franciscan communities in the northern Sierra Madre foothills.
simp_chinese: 赛纳普奇又记作赛纳波斯，是奇瓦瓦以西高地的一处塔拉乌马拉聚落。1694年，它被列为圣伊萨贝尔传教站所属的巡访村，所在道路也经过圣安德烈斯。当时当地传教活动刚开始不久，记录称村中有四十个原住民家庭。后来，它归入圣安德烈斯传教站，成为马德雷山脉北部山麓方济各会传教网络的一部分。

english: Sainiambu lies west of Kapanga in the upper Kasai country. Near Kapanga the Lulua crosses a rocky stretch of rapids before continuing north. In the Lunda kingdom, the Mwant Yaav ruled with hereditary elders and appointed officials; one senior figure, the Lukonkeshia, kept her own court and received tribute.
simp_chinese: 赛尼安布位于卡潘加以西的上开赛地区。卡潘加附近的卢卢阿河穿过岩石急流，继续向北流去。在隆达王国，姆万特·亚夫与世袭长老和任命官员共同执政；一位高级人物卢孔凯希亚拥有自己的宫廷并收取贡赋。

sources.title: john e. flint the cambridge history of africa vbook4you.pdf

english: On the northern shore of the Gulf of St. Lawrence, Saint-Augustin Bay lies among rocky islands near the mouth of the river of the same name. The Innu knew the river as Pakua Shipi, a route into the country beyond the coast. In 1720 François Margane de Lavaltrie received a concession at Saint-Augustin, part of a chain of French fishing and trading establishments along the north shore. Seals, salmon and furs drew merchants to this broken coastline.
simp_chinese: 圣奥古斯丁湾位于圣劳伦斯湾北岸，同名河流在众多岩岛附近入海。因努人称这条河为帕库阿希皮，它通向海岸后方的内陆地区。1720年，弗朗索瓦·马尔加纳·德拉瓦尔特里获得圣奥古斯丁的特许地，这是法国人在北岸设立的一系列渔站与商站之一。海豹、鲑鱼和毛皮吸引商人来到这片曲折海岸。

sources.title: changements soc cul St Augustin intro.html

english: Cape Saint-André projects from western Madagascar into the Mozambique Channel. Its low coast meets warm water flowing between the island and the African mainland. Rivers carry sediment from the interior to nearby bays and tidal flats, where mangroves grow along sheltered shores. The headland is a landmark for vessels following Madagascar's western coast through a region of bays, sandbanks and offshore islands.
simp_chinese: 圣安德烈角从马达加斯加西岸伸入莫桑比克海峡，低平海岸与岛屿和非洲大陆之间的温暖海水相接。河流把内陆泥沙带往附近海湾和潮滩，红树林生长在避风岸边。对沿马达加斯加西海岸航行的船只而言，这片岬地是海湾、沙洲与近海岛屿之间的一处地标。

english: Saint Andrew Bay is a sheltered estuary on the northern Gulf coast of Florida. Its arms extend inland behind a sandy barrier, where shallow waters meet wooded shores and marshes. Indigenous communities occupied the surrounding coast long before Europeans came to the Gulf. The bay’s passages and neighboring lagoons form part of a coastal landscape shaped by waves, shifting sand and the meeting of fresh and salt water.
simp_chinese: 圣安德鲁湾是佛罗里达墨西哥湾北岸一处受庇护的河口海湾。海湾支汊在沙洲后方伸向内陆，浅水与林地海岸、沼泽相接。欧洲人到达墨西哥湾很久以前，原住民社群便居住在周围海岸。海湾水道与邻近潟湖构成一片由波浪、流沙及淡咸水交汇塑造的海岸景观。

english: The Monastery of Saint Anthony stands beneath the Red Sea mountains, near the cave where Anthony the Great withdrew as a hermit. Springs watered a garden of palms and fruit trees within its walls, sustaining a community that became one of the great centres of Egyptian monasticism. The church preserves paintings begun in 1232–33 by an Egyptian artist named Theodore. In the late fifteenth century, an attack devastated the monastery and killed its monks. Syrian monks occupied and helped rebuild it in the early sixteenth century; Ethiopian and Egyptian monks later shared the restored house.
simp_chinese: 圣安多尼修道院坐落在红海山脉脚下，靠近安多尼大帝隐修的洞穴。泉水灌溉着墙内的棕榈与果树园，养育修道社群；这里也成为埃及修道生活的重要中心之一。教堂保存着埃及画师狄奥多尔于1232至1233年开始绘制的壁画。 十五世纪末，一次袭击摧毁修道院，修士皆被杀害。十六世纪初，叙利亚修士在此居住并协助重建；此后，埃塞俄比亚和埃及修士曾共同生活在修复后的院内。

english:
Saint Augustine Bay opens on Madagascar's southwestern coast at the mouth of the Onilahy River. Pale limestone cliffs rise near the river, whose valley reaches inland from the Mozambique Channel. The bay offered ships a place to obtain provisions and brought foreign merchants into contact with the communities of the coast.

English vessels called frequently during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, exchanging goods for food and other supplies, as well as enslaved people destined for distant settlements. An English attempt to establish a settlement in 1645 was short-lived, but the bay remained a place of maritime trade. By the beginning of the eighteenth century Sakalava rulers sought to control commerce in the southwest, as political competition and overseas demand reshaped relations around the Onilahy.
simp_chinese:
圣奥古斯丁湾位于马达加斯加西南岸，乌尼拉希河在此入海。浅色石灰岩峭壁耸立在河流附近，河谷从莫桑比克海峡伸向内陆。海湾是船只获取补给的地方，也使外国商人与沿岸社群相遇。

十七至十八世纪，英国船只频繁停靠，以货物交换食物、其他补给，以及被运往遥远聚落的奴役人口。1645年英国人在此建立聚落的尝试并未持久，但海湾仍是海上贸易地点。十八世纪初，萨卡拉瓦统治者寻求控制西南部商业，政治竞争与海外需求共同改变了乌尼拉希河周边的关系。

english:
Saint-Avold grew around the Benedictine abbey of Saint-Nabor, whose name was gradually transformed into that of the town. The abbey possessed relics of the martyr Nabor and enjoyed the protection of the bishops of Metz. Its community and lands made it a lasting centre of religious life in the eastern part of Lorraine.

The monks adopted the Bursfeld reform under Abbot Adam of Roupeldange in 1512 and joined the Lorraine congregation of Saint-Vanne in 1607. Their conventual buildings were rebuilt between 1720 and 1740, followed by the abbey church. The French Revolution brought the community’s monastic life to an end in March 1790. In 1792 the abbey church was exchanged for the old parish church, while the convent buildings passed to other uses and were sold in 1798.
simp_chinese:
圣阿沃尔德围绕圣纳博尔本笃会修道院发展，修道院的名字逐渐演变为城镇名称。修道院拥有殉道者纳博尔的圣髑，受到梅斯主教保护；修士团体与其土地使这里长期成为洛林东部的宗教中心。

修士在院长鲁佩尔当日的亚当领导下于1512年接受布尔斯费尔德改革，1607年加入洛林的圣瓦讷会。修道院建筑于1720年至1740年间重建，修道院教堂也随后重建。1790年三月法国大革命结束了修道生活，1792年修道院教堂与旧堂区教堂交换用途；院舍转作其他用途，并于1798年出售。

english: Saint-Brieuc grew around its cathedral on the northern coast of Brittany, above the valleys leading down to the harbour of Le Légué. The town was an episcopal centre, its church and market serving the surrounding country. Near the mouth of the Gouët, the tower of Cesson guarded the approach from the bay. During the Wars of the League in the late sixteenth century, the fortress became a contested position between supporters of the Catholic League and the royal party. Its commanding site helped control access to the town from the sea.
simp_chinese: 圣布里厄在布列塔尼北岸围绕座堂发展，位于通往勒莱盖港的山谷上方。城镇是主教中心，教堂和市集服务周边乡村。古埃河口附近的塞松塔守卫从海湾进入的通道。十六世纪末同盟战争期间，天主教同盟与王党争夺这座堡垒。其居高临海的位置有助于控制从海上通往城镇的入口。

english:
Saint-Claude grew around an ancient abbey in the Jura, founded by the monks Romanus and Lupicinus. First known for Saint Oyend, it later took the name of Saint Claude, whose tomb made it a renowned destination for medieval pilgrims. Kings and ordinary visitors came to honour the saint's relics in the mountain monastery, among them Louis XI of France.

In 1742 the Benedictine abbey was secularized and Saint-Claude became the seat of a new diocese; the old abbey church became its cathedral of Saint-Pierre. During the Revolution, the saint's revered relics were burned in 1794, though the left forearm was saved. The diocese was suppressed after the Concordat of 1801 and restored in 1822, giving the old monastic town an episcopal role once more.
simp_chinese:
圣克洛德围绕汝拉山中的一座古老修道院发展，修道院由修士罗马努斯和卢皮基努斯创建。它最初以圣奥扬闻名，后来以圣克洛德命名；圣人的墓使这里成为朝圣目的地。国王和普通信徒都来到山中修道院敬奉他的圣髑，其中包括法国国王路易十一。

1742年，修道院世俗化，圣克洛德成为新教区的主教驻地，修道院教堂改为圣彼得主教座堂。大革命期间，圣人的遗骸于1794年被焚，左前臂得以保存。1801年政教协约后教区被撤销，1822年又获恢复，这座古老修道院城镇重新成为主教驻地。

english: Saint-Dié grew around a religious community in the upper Meurthe valley, among the wooded mountains of the Vosges. Its churches and cloister form a great complex of pink sandstone. Fire damaged their roofs in 1554, and another blaze devastated much of the town in 1757. Stanisław Leszczyński, duke of Lorraine, had the town rebuilt on a more regular plan; in 1777 Saint-Dié became the seat of a bishop.
simp_chinese: 圣迪耶兴起于默尔特河上游谷地的一处宗教社团周围，四面是孚日山区的森林。当地教堂与回廊组成一片粉红砂岩建筑群。1554年的火灾毁坏了部分屋顶，1757年的另一场大火又烧毁城镇的大部分。洛林公爵斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基下令按更规整的规划重建城镇；1777年，圣迪耶成为主教座所在地。

sources.title: Georges Flayeux-La Vallee de la Haute-Meurthe.pdf

english: Saint-Étienne grew in a coal-bearing district of the Forez, where metalworkers developed a reputation for making arms. The craft involved many specialised trades, from forging to the finishing of weapons. In 1765 the existing manufacture of weapons received the title of Royal Arms Manufacture. Workshops and dwellings multiplied together in the eighteenth century, as the organisation of production drew craftsmen and workers into the expanding town.
simp_chinese: 圣艾蒂安兴起于福雷的产煤地区，当地金属匠以制造武器闻名。这门手艺涉及从锻造到成品修整的许多专业工种。1765年，已有的武器制造所获得皇家兵工厂称号。十八世纪，生产组织的发展吸引工匠和工人来到不断扩大的城镇，作坊与住宅也一同增加。

english:
Saint-Florentin rises above the Armançon at the meeting of old provincial boundaries. Its church and castle were associated with the counts of Champagne, while a community of canons served the relics of Saint Florentin. The town's elevated position and fortifications made it a target in the conflicts of the later Middle Ages and the Wars of Religion.

Work on the present parish church began in 1520, combining late Gothic forms with Renaissance decoration. Its stained glass and carved altarpieces were added during the sixteenth century, the earliest dated window bearing the year 1524. Construction continued into the next century: the architect Jean Boullon worked on the transept between 1610 and 1613, and two further side chapels of the church were planned for the nave in 1617.
simp_chinese:
圣弗洛朗坦耸立在阿尔芒松河上方，位于旧省区的交界处。教堂和城堡与香槟伯爵有关，教士团则侍奉圣弗洛朗坦的圣髑。城镇的高地位置和防御工事使它成为中世纪晚期及宗教战争中的争夺目标。

现存教堂于1520年开始建造，结合了晚期哥特式形制与文艺复兴装饰。彩色玻璃和雕刻祭坛画在十六世纪陆续加入，最早有日期的玻璃窗标着1524年。工程延续到下一个世纪：建筑师让·布永于1610年至1613年间负责耳堂工程，1617年，中殿还计划增建两座侧礼拜堂。

english: Saint-Flour rises on a volcanic height above the valley of the Ander, overlooking the highlands of southern Auvergne. Its religious importance grew around the shrine of Saint Flour. In 1317 Pope John XXII created a diocese here from part of the vast bishopric of Clermont. The cathedral was rebuilt between 1396 and 1466, its dark stone walls and towers commanding the upper town.
simp_chinese: 圣弗卢尔耸立在昂代尔河谷上方的火山高地上，俯瞰奥弗涅南部群山。城镇的宗教地位围绕圣弗卢尔的圣所逐渐增长。1317年，教宗若望二十二世从广大的克莱蒙教区划出一部分，在此设立主教区。大教堂于1396至1466年重建，深色石墙和塔楼雄踞上城。

english: Saint-Gaudens stands above the Garonne with the Pyrenees to the south. Its collegiate church, dedicated to Saint Peter and Saint Gaudens, grew from a smaller early sanctuary into a substantial Romanesque building. The town suffered heavily in the Wars of Religion. On 2 August 1569 Huguenot troops led by the Count of Montgomery plundered Saint-Gaudens, devastating the collegiate church and its archives as well as the Dominican convent.
simp_chinese: 圣戈当位于加龙河上方，南面是比利牛斯山。供奉圣伯多禄与圣戈当的协同教堂从一座较小的早期圣所发展为宏大的罗马式建筑。宗教战争给城镇带来沉重灾难。1569年8月2日，蒙哥马利伯爵率领的胡格诺军队洗劫圣戈当，破坏了协同教堂及其档案，也毁坏了多明我会修道院。

english: St George’s Channel separates New Britain from New Ireland in the Bismarck archipelago. Island communities travelled these waters before European ships arrived. In 1700 William Dampier rounded Cape St George and continued west, establishing that New Britain was separated from New Guinea by a strait.
simp_chinese: 圣乔治海峡将俾斯麦群岛中的新不列颠与新爱尔兰隔开。欧洲船只到来之前，岛屿社群已在这些水域航行。1700年，威廉·丹皮尔绕过圣乔治角继续向西，确认新不列颠与新几内亚之间有海峡相隔。

english: St. George's Bay opens onto the Gulf of St. Lawrence on Newfoundland's western coast. Its wide mouth lies between the Port au Port Peninsula and Cape Anguille, with rivers flowing into the sheltered inner bay. Mi'kmaq communities lived around these shores and travelled between the coast and the interior. In 1767 James Cook surveyed the western coast of Newfoundland and recorded a Mi'kmaq village in the bay, adding its inlets and headlands to his charts.
simp_chinese: 圣乔治湾位于纽芬兰西岸，向圣劳伦斯湾敞开。宽阔的湾口介于波尔托波尔半岛与昂吉耶角之间，河流注入受庇护的内湾。米克马克社群生活在海湾沿岸，往来于海岸和内陆。1767年，詹姆斯·库克测绘纽芬兰西岸，记录了湾内一座米克马克村落，并将曲折海岸绘入海图。

english: Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne stands in the Arc valley on a route through the Alps towards Italy. Its cathedral preserves relics venerated as those of Saint John the Baptist, whose cult and the foundation of the bishopric are recorded from the sixth century. Rebuilt in the eleventh century and enlarged in the fifteenth, the church contains carved walnut choir stalls, a cloister and a crypt. The shrine gave the mountain town a religious importance beyond its valley.
simp_chinese: 圣让德莫里耶讷坐落在阿尔克河谷，处于穿越阿尔卑斯山通往意大利的道路上。主教座堂保存着被奉为施洗者圣若翰遗骸的圣物，对圣人的敬奉和主教区的建立自六世纪已有记载。教堂十一世纪重建、十五世纪扩建，拥有雕刻精美的胡桃木唱经席、回廊和地下室。圣所使这座山城拥有超出河谷的宗教地位。

english: Saint-Jean-Pied-de-Port lies where the Nive streams meet, at the foot of the passes over the Pyrenees. Pilgrims bound for Santiago de Compostela passed through its streets beneath the castle of the kings of Navarre. The town became a prize in the struggle for Navarre after 1512; by 1530 Lower Navarre and its capital had been left to Henri II d'Albret. A rectangular citadel was built around the old castle in 1624–1627.
simp_chinese: 圣让皮耶德波尔位于尼夫河支流汇合处，坐落在翻越比利牛斯山的山口脚下。前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的朝圣者穿过城镇，走过纳瓦拉国王城堡下方的街道。1512年以后，城镇成为争夺纳瓦拉的目标；至1530年，下纳瓦拉及其首府留给了亨利二世·达尔布雷。1624至1627年，一座矩形要塞环绕旧城堡建成。

english:
The monastery of Saint Catherine stands among the granite mountains of southern Sinai, beneath the peak revered as Mount Sinai. Its fortified walls enclose a church and the site traditionally associated with the burning bush seen by Moses. Byzantine emperor Justinian ordered the monastery built in the sixth century to shelter the community of monks who had gathered in this remote landscape.

Across the centuries the monastery preserved a remarkable library of religious and secular manuscripts. Its books were written in Greek, Arabic, Syriac, Georgian, Armenian and other languages, reflecting the many Christian communities that maintained ties with Sinai. Pilgrims came to the holy mountain and the monastery, while its monks lived under successive Muslim rulers. In the Ottoman period the community became predominantly Greek Orthodox, continuing a monastic tradition rooted in late antiquity.
simp_chinese:
圣凯瑟琳修道院坐落在西奈南部的花岗岩群山中，位于被尊为西奈山的山峰下方。坚固的围墙内有一座教堂，以及传统上认为摩西见到燃烧荆棘的地方。六世纪，拜占庭皇帝查士丁尼下令修建修道院，为聚集在偏远山地中的修士提供庇护。

几个世纪以来，修道院保存了丰富的宗教与世俗手稿。书籍使用希腊语、阿拉伯语、叙利亚语、格鲁吉亚语、亚美尼亚语等多种语言，反映了与西奈保持联系的众多基督教社区。朝圣者来到圣山和修道院，修士则生活在历代穆斯林统治者的治下。奥斯曼时期，修道群体主要由希腊正教徒组成，延续着古代晚期以来的传统。

english: The St. Lawrence estuary broadens between the north shore and the Gaspé Peninsula before opening into the gulf. Beneath it runs the deep Laurentian Channel, carrying cold Atlantic water inland below the river's fresher surface flow. Tides mix the waters and bring nutrients upward, supporting plankton, fish and whales. Belugas inhabit the estuary and the Saguenay, while winter ice spreads across the water between the riverbanks.
simp_chinese: 圣劳伦斯河口在北岸与加斯佩半岛之间逐渐展宽，通向圣劳伦斯湾。深邃的劳伦森海槽从河口下方穿过，将寒冷的大西洋海水输向内陆；较淡的河水则在表层流向外海。潮汐搅动水体，将养分带向上层，滋养浮游生物、鱼群和鲸类。白鲸栖息在河口与萨格奈河，冬季海冰则在两岸之间展开。

english:
The Gulf of Saint Lawrence opens the great river system of northeastern North America to the Atlantic. Indigenous peoples travelled and fished along its shores before European expeditions arrived. In 1534 Jacques Cartier entered the gulf through the Strait of Belle Isle, explored its coasts and encountered Indigenous people, including Mi'kmaq communities with whom his party traded.

On his following voyage in 1535 Cartier travelled up the Saint Lawrence River. The gulf later became a maritime approach to New France, linking Atlantic shipping with settlements and trade networks inland. Seasonal ice, storms and shoals made navigation difficult, while fisheries and exchanges continued to connect communities around its shores.
simp_chinese:
圣劳伦斯湾使北美东北部的河流系统通向大西洋。欧洲远征到来之前，原住民已沿海岸航行和捕鱼。1534年，雅克·卡蒂埃经贝尔岛海峡进入海湾，考察沿岸，并与包括米克马克人在内的原住民相遇和交换物品。

卡蒂埃于1535年的下一次航行中沿圣劳伦斯河深入内陆。海湾后来成为进入新法兰西的海上通道，将大西洋航运同内陆聚落及贸易网络联系起来。季节海冰、风暴和浅滩使航行困难，渔业与交换则继续联系湾岸各地社群。

english: Saint-Lizier rises above the Salat, enclosed in part by walls inherited from antiquity. It was the seat of the bishops of Couserans, with churches in the upper town and the suburb below. Their chapters were united at Notre-Dame-de-la-Sède in the seventeenth century. The bishops also built a palace against the ancient walls, giving their mountain diocese a residence that overlooked the town and the valley.
simp_chinese: 圣利济耶高踞萨拉特河上方，部分城墙承袭自古代。这里是库瑟朗主教的驻地，上城和下方郊区各有教堂。十七世纪，两个教士团合并于圣母座堂。主教们还倚靠古城墙修建宫殿，为山区教区建立一座俯瞰城镇与河谷的住所。

english: San Lorenzo Island lies off Callao, guarding the approaches to the harbor of Lima. Its barren ridges rise from the Pacific beside the smaller island of El Frontón, with channels between the islands and the mainland. During the colonial period the island offered a base to foreign raiders who threatened the Spanish port. Francis Drake entered the waters off Callao in 1579, exposing the vulnerability of the wealthy Pacific harbor to attack from the sea.
simp_chinese: 圣洛伦索岛位于卡亚俄外海，守望通往利马港口的航道。荒凉的山脊从太平洋中升起，旁边是较小的埃尔丰通岛，岛屿与大陆之间有水道相通。殖民时期，这座岛曾为威胁西班牙港口的外国劫掠者提供据点。1579年，弗朗西斯·德雷克进入卡亚俄外海，显示这座富庶的太平洋港口容易受到来自海上的袭击。

english: The Saint Lucia Channel separates Martinique from Saint Lucia, joining the Atlantic to the Caribbean Sea. About seventeen miles wide, it forms a break between two of the mountainous islands of the Lesser Antilles. The channel lies open to the easterly winds that cross the Atlantic, in contrast to the sheltered waters on the western sides of the islands. It provides a passage between the two island coasts.
simp_chinese: 圣卢西亚海峡分隔马提尼克与圣卢西亚，连接大西洋和加勒比海。海峡宽约十七英里，是小安的列斯群岛两座多山岛屿之间的一处缺口。与岛屿西侧受庇护的水域不同，海峡直接面对横渡大西洋的东风，并为往来两岛海岸的船只提供通道。

english:
Saint-Malo stands on a rocky site at the mouth of the Rance, its walls facing the tides and reefs of the Breton coast. Its harbour fostered a community of sailors, merchants and shipowners whose voyages reached far beyond the Channel. Fishing fleets sailed toward Newfoundland, while privateers used the port as a base during wars at sea.

In 1534 Jacques Cartier sailed from Saint-Malo on the first of his voyages to the St Lawrence region, claiming land for Francis I. During the Wars of Religion the town's inhabitants asserted their independence, maintaining a short-lived republic from 1590 to 1594. Their choice reflected both the political uncertainty of the kingdom and the confidence of a maritime community accustomed to defending its own interests. In the eighteenth century Saint-Malo's privateers included René Duguay-Trouin, who led an expedition against Rio de Janeiro in 1711. Wealth from overseas ventures and maritime warfare supported the great houses of shipowners, while the harbour's difficult approaches and powerful tides remained central to the town's defence and navigation.
simp_chinese:
圣马洛坐落在朗斯河口的岩石地带，城墙面向布列塔尼海岸的潮汐与礁石。港口孕育出水手、商人与船主的社群，他们的航程远远超出英吉利海峡。渔船驶向纽芬兰，海上战争期间私掠船也以此为基地。

1534年，雅克·卡蒂埃从圣马洛出发，开始首次前往圣劳伦斯地区的航行，并为弗朗索瓦一世宣称土地。宗教战争期间，市民主张独立，1590至1594年维持了短暂的共和国。这一选择既反映王国的政治不确定，也体现了习惯维护自身利益的海港社群的自信。十八世纪，圣马洛的私掠船长包括勒内·迪盖—特鲁安，他于1711年率远征队攻打里约热内卢。海外事业与海上战争所得财富支持船主建造宏大宅邸，港口艰险的入口与强烈潮汐则始终影响城镇的防御和航行。

english: The Gulf of Saint-Malo lies between Brittany and the Cotentin peninsula, its waters scattered with islands and reefs. Great tides uncover broad stretches of shore and run through the channels around the Channel Islands. Saint-Malo's harbour supported merchants and privateers who sailed from its fortified town into the Channel and the Atlantic. Wrecks on the reefs outside the port bear witness to the hazards of the approaches.
simp_chinese: 圣马洛湾位于布列塔尼与科唐坦半岛之间，水域中散布岛屿和暗礁。巨大的潮差使大片海岸时隐时现，潮水穿过海峡群岛周围的航道。圣马洛港支持商人和私掠船从设防城镇驶往海峡及大西洋。港外礁石上的沉船见证了进港水道的危险。

english:
Founded in the 11th century, Saint-Marcellin was the seat of the Dauphiné Council between 1337 and 1340. It became famous for its soft cheese with a bloomy rind, first served to Louis XI in 1461.

The council left for Grenoble in 1340, where it would become the Parlement of Dauphiné, but Saint-Marcellin kept the favour of the last Dauphin, Humbert II. In 1343 he granted its townspeople a charter of liberties, franchises and privileges, and allowed them to wall what was by then one of the important towns of the region. Humbert had no children, and six years later he sold the Dauphiné to the House of Valois. Saint-Marcellin passed with it to the young prince Charles, the first heir of the French crown to bear the title of Dauphin.
simp_chinese:
圣马塞兰建于11世纪，1337至1340年间作为多芬议会所在地。其以柔软的白霉奶酪闻名，1461年曾进献给路易十一世。

1340年议会迁往格勒诺布尔，日后在那里成为多菲内高等法院，但圣马塞兰仍受末代多芬安贝尔二世的眷顾。1343年，他颁给城中居民一份自由与特权的特许状，并准许他们为这座已是地区要地的城镇筑起城墙。安贝尔二世膝下无子，六年后把多菲内卖给了瓦卢瓦家族，圣马塞兰随之归于年轻的王子查理。从他开始，法国王位继承人都以“多芬”为称号。

english:
Saint-Mihiel grew beside the Meuse around the Benedictine abbey of Saint-Michel. Founded in the eighth century and moved down to the river in the ninth, the abbey became a centre of learning and religious life in the duchy of Bar. Its library brought together manuscripts and printed books over many centuries.

The sculptor Ligier Richier, born at Saint-Mihiel around 1500, worked for the court of Lorraine and created religious works for the town. A convert to Protestantism, he left for Geneva in the 1560s. The abbey joined the reforming congregation of Saint-Vanne in the early seventeenth century and was rebuilt after the devastation of war. Its library received new rooms around 1775; the Revolution dissolved the monastery, but many of its books remained together.
simp_chinese:
圣米耶勒在默兹河畔的圣米歇尔本笃会修道院周围发展。修道院创建于八世纪，九世纪迁至河边，成为巴尔公国的学术与宗教中心。其图书馆历经数世纪积累了手抄本和印刷书籍。

雕刻家利吉耶·里希耶约于1500年出生于圣米耶勒，曾为洛林宫廷工作，并为城镇创作宗教作品。他皈依新教，1560年代离开洛林前往日内瓦。修道院于十七世纪初加入圣瓦讷改革会，战乱破坏后得到重建。图书馆约于1775年迁入新厅室；大革命解散修道院，但许多藏书仍得以集中保存。

english:
Saint-Omer grew up around the abbey of Saint-Bertin, in the marshes of the Aa, with the collegiate church of Notre-Dame beside it. In 1340 an Anglo-Flemish army led by Robert of Artois was driven from its outskirts by Eudes IV, Duke of Burgundy. From 1384 the town belonged to the Burgundian Netherlands. In 1559 it became a bishopric, and Notre-Dame was made a cathedral; from 1581 the town belonged to the Spanish Netherlands.

In 1593 the Jesuit Robert Persons founded an English college here, with the support of Philip II of Spain, to educate boys from English Catholic families. Among its eighteenth-century pupils were John Carroll, later founder of Georgetown, and his cousin Charles Carroll of Carrollton. Louis XIV forced Saint-Omer to surrender in 1677 after a seventeen-day siege, and the Treaty of Nijmegen in 1678 confirmed the annexation. The college continued until 1762, when the Jesuits and their pupils moved to Bruges.
simp_chinese:
圣奥梅尔围绕阿河沼泽中的圣贝尔坦修道院发展起来，旁边是圣母协同教堂。1340年，罗贝尔·德·阿图瓦率领的英格兰—佛兰德联军在郊外被勃艮第公爵厄德四世击退。1384年起该城属于勃艮第尼德兰。1559年它成为主教区，圣母教堂升为主教座堂；1581年起该城属于西属尼德兰。

1593年，耶稣会士罗伯特·珀森斯在腓力二世支持下在此创办英国学院，教育英国天主教家庭的男孩。18世纪的学生中有后来创办乔治敦大学的约翰·卡罗尔，以及他的堂亲卡罗尔顿的查尔斯·卡罗尔。路易十四于1677年围攻十七天，迫使圣奥梅尔投降，1678年《奈梅亨条约》确认了合并。学院一直办到1762年，耶稣会士和学生随后迁往布鲁日。

english: The monastery of Saint Paul the Anchorite stands in Egypt's Eastern Desert, among the mountains west of the Red Sea. Tradition places it near the cave where Saint Paul lived as a hermit. The remote community shared a long history with the nearby monastery of Saint Anthony. After a prolonged period of abandonment, monks from Saint Anthony's returned to Saint Paul's, and Pope John XVI of Alexandria supported its extensive rebuilding in 1701.
simp_chinese: 隐修者圣保罗修道院位于埃及东部沙漠，在红海以西的群山之间。传统认为，它靠近圣保罗隐修的洞穴。这处偏远的修道群体与附近圣安多尼修道院有着长久联系。经过长期荒废后，圣安多尼修道院的修士来到圣保罗修道院，亚历山大教宗约翰十六世支持其于1701年进行大规模重建。

sources.title: Monastery of Saint Paul the Anchorite

english: Saint Paul is a volcanic island in the southern Indian Ocean, south of Amsterdam Island. Its crater opens to the sea, and much of the volcano's northeastern half lies beneath the water. In 1696 Willem de Vlamingh's Dutch expedition was directed to call at Saint Paul and Amsterdam on its way towards the Southland.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岛是南印度洋的一座火山岛，位于阿姆斯特丹岛以南。火山口向大海敞开，火山东北半部的大部分位于水下。1696年，威廉·德·弗拉明的荷兰远征队奉命在前往南方大陆途中到访圣保罗岛和阿姆斯特丹岛。

english: East of Saint Paul and Amsterdam islands, the open southern Indian Ocean is swept by westerly winds. Saint Paul is a volcanic island with a crater open to the sea. In 1696 Willem de Vlamingh's Dutch expedition was directed to call at both islands on its way towards the Southland.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岛与阿姆斯特丹岛以东，开阔的南印度洋受到西风吹拂。圣保罗是一座火山岛，火山口向大海敞开。1696年，威廉·德·弗拉明的荷兰远征队奉命在前往南方大陆途中到访两岛。

english: South of Saint Paul Island, the westerlies sweep the open Indian Ocean. Saint Paul is a small volcanic island whose crater opens to the sea. Dutch ships used these southern winds on the passage to Java after Hendrik Brouwer tested an eastward route from the Cape in 1611.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岛以南，西风横扫开阔的印度洋。圣保罗是一座小火山岛，火山口向大海敞开。1611年亨德里克·布劳威尔试行从好望角向东的航线后，荷兰船只利用南方西风驶往爪哇。

english: West of Saint Paul Island, the southern Indian Ocean is crossed by the westerly winds. Saint Paul is a volcano rising from this remote sea, south of Amsterdam Island. In 1696 Willem de Vlamingh's Dutch expedition was directed to call at both islands on the way to the Southland.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岛以西的南印度洋受到西风吹拂。圣保罗是一座从偏远海域中升起的火山岛，位于阿姆斯特丹岛以南。1696年，威廉·德·弗拉明的荷兰远征队奉命在前往南方大陆途中到访两岛。

english: North of Saint Paul Island, the southern Indian Ocean lies along the westerly wind belt. Saint Paul and nearby Amsterdam are isolated volcanic islands. In 1696 Willem de Vlamingh's Dutch expedition was directed to visit both while sailing towards the Southland.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岛以北的南印度洋位于西风带。圣保罗和附近的阿姆斯特丹是孤立的火山岛。1696年，威廉·德·弗拉明的荷兰远征队奉命在驶往南方大陆途中到访两岛。

english: Saint Paul is a small volcanic island in the southern Indian Ocean, south of Amsterdam Island. Its great crater holds a basin sheltered by the surrounding cliffs. The island was known to Portuguese and Dutch navigators on the route to Asia; in 1696 Willem de Vlamingh visited it while searching for a missing ship. At that time a bar of pebbles closed the crater basin from the sea, forcing his boats to be hauled across it. The bar was later breached, opening a narrow passage into the basin.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗岛是南印度洋上的一座小火山岛，位于阿姆斯特丹岛以南。巨大的火山口中有一片水域，四周峭壁提供遮蔽。航行亚洲航线的葡萄牙与荷兰水手早已知道这座岛；1696年，威廉·德弗拉明在搜寻失踪船只时到访。当时一条卵石堤把火山口水域与大海隔开，船只必须拖过石堤才能进入。后来海水冲开石堤，形成一条狭窄通道。

english:
The Saint Paul River descends from the highlands of Guinea through the forests of Liberia to the Atlantic near Cape Mesurado. Its upper course is known as the Diani or Niandi. Villages along the river belong to a region of dense forest and abundant rainfall, where waterways provide routes through the interior. Near its mouth the river enters the coastal trading world that connected African communities with ships from across the Atlantic.

The later city of Tubmanburg lies here.
simp_chinese:
圣保罗河从几内亚高地流下，穿过利比里亚森林，在梅苏拉多角附近注入大西洋。上游称迪亚尼河或尼安迪河。沿河村落位于森林茂密、雨量充沛的地区，水道为穿越内陆提供通路。接近河口时，河流进入沿海贸易世界，非洲社群在此与远渡大西洋而来的船只接触。

后来的杜伯曼堡即位于此地。

english:
Saint-Pol stands on the Ternoise in the old county that bore its name. A castle rose here in the eleventh century, and the counts later fortified the town, whose inhabitants received its communal charter in 1202. Its position in Artois placed it among the contested strongholds of the northern French frontier.

Louis of Luxembourg, count of Saint-Pol and constable of France, was executed for treason in 1475; Louis XI confiscated his family's possessions. In the sixteenth century Francis I ordered the castle's defences modernized under the direction of a skilled Italian engineer, but imperial troops took both castle and town in 1537. Saint-Pol came under Spanish authority, and the Ternois and Artois were joined to France by the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659.
simp_chinese:
圣波勒位于泰尔努瓦兹河畔，是同名旧伯国的中心。十一世纪这里建起一座城堡，伯爵后来又为城镇修筑防御工事，居民于1202年获得自治宪章。阿图瓦的位置使它成为法国北部边境上屡遭争夺的据点之一。

圣波勒伯爵、法国王室统帅卢森堡的路易于1475年以叛国罪被处决，路易十一没收了其家族的财产。十六世纪，弗朗索瓦一世下令由意大利工程师改进城堡防御，但帝国军队仍于1537年夺取城堡和城镇。圣波勒随后处于西班牙统治之下，1659年《比利牛斯条约》使泰尔努瓦和阿图瓦归入法国。

english: Saint-Pons-de-Thomières grew around a Benedictine abbey founded in 936 by Raymond Pons, count of Toulouse. The fortified settlement around the abbey faced Thomières on the opposite bank of the Jaur, where another walled quarter had streets of shops. In the early fourteenth century Pope John XXII made Saint-Pons the seat of a new diocese, and the abbey church became a cathedral. A Gothic replacement for its Romanesque choir was begun in the late fifteenth century, but the work was still unfinished when Protestant forces took the town in 1567. The cloister and cathedral suffered severe damage during the Wars of Religion, and restoration took many years. The cathedral chapter was secularized in 1615. In the seventeenth century Bishop Percin de Montgaillard founded a college, restored episcopal buildings and reformed the hospital, leaving his mark on the town's religious and civic life.
simp_chinese: 圣蓬斯德托米埃尔围绕一座本笃会修道院发展起来。修道院由图卢兹伯爵雷蒙·蓬斯于936年创建，周围形成设防聚落；若尔河对岸的托米埃尔则有自己的城墙和店铺街道。十四世纪初，教宗若望二十二世将圣蓬斯设为新教区的主教驻地，修道院教堂也成为主教座堂。十五世纪末，人们开始以哥特式唱诗班席取代原有的罗曼式部分，但工程尚未完工，1567年新教军队便攻占了城镇。宗教战争期间回廊与座堂遭到严重破坏，修复历时多年。1615年，座堂参事会转为世俗参事会。十七世纪，主教佩尔桑·德·蒙盖亚尔创办学院，修复主教区建筑并改革医院，在城镇的宗教与公共生活中留下印记。

english:
Saint-Quentin grew on the Somme around the church of its namesake saint. A centre of textile production and a fortified town of Vermandois, it stood on the northern approaches to the French kingdom. Its great collegiate church embodied both the religious importance and the wealth of the town.

In August 1557, during the war against Spain, Saint-Quentin came under siege. Despite determined resistance, the town fell on 27 August and was plundered. Artillery and musket fire damaged the collegiate church and destroyed part of its furnishings, and its canons found it badly hurt when they returned after the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis restored the town to France in 1559. Repairing the church and recovering from the occupation were costly tasks for the surviving community.
simp_chinese:
圣康坦在索姆河畔围绕供奉同名圣人的教堂发展起来。这座韦尔芒杜瓦的设防城镇是纺织业中心，位于进入法国王国的北方通道上。宏大的圣康坦同修教堂体现了城市的宗教地位与财富。

1557年八月，对西班牙的战争中圣康坦遭到围攻。尽管居民与守军顽强抵抗，城镇仍于8月27日陷落并遭劫掠。火炮和火绳枪射击损坏了同修教堂，并毁掉部分陈设。1559年《卡托-康布雷齐和约》将城市归还法国，教士们返回时发现教堂已伤痕累累。修复教堂、从占领中恢复，是当地社群面临的沉重任务。

english: Cape Saint Vincent projects from the southwestern coast of Madagascar into the Mozambique Channel, south of Morombe. This coast is bordered by reefs and shallow waters, with fishing grounds beyond the sandy shore. The Vezo, known for their seafaring and fishing, travel along the western coast in canoes. Offshore the channel separates Madagascar from Africa, while inland the dry country rises away from the coast.
simp_chinese: 圣文森特角从马达加斯加西南海岸伸入莫桑比克海峡，位于莫龙贝以南。这段海岸外缘分布礁石和浅水，沙岸之外便有渔场。以航海和捕鱼闻名的韦佐人乘独木舟沿西岸往来。海峡分隔着马达加斯加与非洲，向内陆则进入远离海岸的干旱地区。

english: Saintala lies in the western Odisha country south of Balangir. Its shrine to Chandi honours the goddess in the form of Mahishamardini, the slayer of the buffalo demon. Sculptural remains at the site include an image of Vishnu’s ten incarnations and a broken doorway carved with the river goddesses Ganga and Yamuna. Alongside other temples of the upper Mahanadi region, the shrine preserves traces of a long tradition of stone carving and goddess worship.
simp_chinese: 圣塔拉位于奥里萨西部、博兰吉尔以南。当地昌迪神庙供奉女神降伏水牛魔的摩醯沙末底尼形象。遗存的雕刻包括毗湿奴十化身像，以及刻有恒河与亚穆纳河女神的残破门框。这座神庙与上默哈讷迪河流域的其他寺庙一起，保留了悠久石雕艺术和女神崇拜传统的痕迹。

english: Inland from the north shore of the St Lawrence, the Sainte-Marguerite River descends through forested highlands towards the sea. Innu families travelled between this interior and the coast, returning by rivers such as the Sainte-Marguerite after winter on their hunting grounds. At Uashat, on the bay of Sept-Îles, summer gatherings brought families together for ceremonies, trade and preparations for the journey inland again. A fur-trading post was established on the bay in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 圣玛格丽特河从圣劳伦斯河北岸的内陆高地流下，穿过森林奔向大海。因努家庭往来于内陆与海岸，在猎场过冬后，沿圣玛格丽特河等水道返回。夏天，各家在七岛湾的瓦沙特相聚，举行仪式、进行贸易，并为再次进入内陆作准备。十七世纪，湾畔建立了一座毛皮贸易站。

english: Cape Sainte-Marie, also called Cape Vohimena, is Madagascar's southernmost point. Wind sweeps the dry coast, where thorny vegetation and dunes meet cliffs above the Indian Ocean. The cape marks the turn between the island's southern and western shores, a conspicuous landmark for vessels rounding Madagascar. The surrounding Androy country is home to distinctive plants and land tortoises adapted to the island's arid southern environment.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽角又称武希梅纳角，是马达加斯加最南端。风吹过干燥的海岸，荆棘植被和沙丘在印度洋上方的崖壁附近相接。岬角标示岛屿南岸与西岸之间的转折，是绕行马达加斯加船只的显著地标。周围的安德罗伊地区生长着独特植物，也有适应岛屿南部干旱环境的陆龟。

english:
Sainte Marie Island lies off Madagascar's eastern coast, where sheltered anchorages offered a contrast with exposed Indian Ocean shores. Fishing, cultivation and exchange with the mainland supported local communities, while the island's position made it accessible to vessels moving through the western Indian Ocean. Winds and seasonal storms shaped the timing of travel. A usable anchorage could attract outsiders seeking food, water, repairs or a place to wait for better conditions.

In the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, the island became a base for pirates operating along Indian Ocean trade routes. Its sheltered bays, fresh water and provisions attracted passing ships. In 1750 Bétia, daughter of the Betsimisaraka ruler Ratsimilaho, signed an agreement ceding the island to France, against local opposition. Conflict followed, and French administration withdrew after violence in 1754.
simp_chinese:
圣玛丽岛位于马达加斯加东岸外，避风锚地同暴露于印度洋的海岸形成对照。捕鱼、耕作及同大陆交换支撑当地社群，岛屿位置又便于往来西印度洋的船只抵达。风向与季节风暴影响出航时间，能够停泊的港湾吸引外来者补充食物和淡水、维修船只，或等待较好海况。

十七世纪末至十八世纪初，圣玛丽岛成为在印度洋商路活动的海盗基地。避风海湾、淡水和补给吸引过往船只。1750年，贝齐米萨拉卡统治者拉齐米拉胡的女儿贝蒂娅签署协议，将岛屿割让给法国，但遭到当地反对。此后发生冲突，1754年暴力事件后法国行政人员撤离。

english: Sainte-Suzanne crowns a rocky spur above the River Erve, its walls enclosing a small town beside a strong castle. The height gave its defenders a commanding view over the countryside of Maine. During the Hundred Years' War the English took the fortress under John Fastolf in 1425, and French forces recovered it in 1439. The place retained military importance during the Wars of Religion. In 1604 Guillaume Fouquet de la Varenne acquired the old fortress and began transforming it into a residence, giving the medieval stronghold a new purpose.
simp_chinese: 圣苏珊坐落在埃尔夫河上方的岩石山脊上，城墙环绕小镇与坚固城堡。高处使守军得以俯瞰曼恩乡间。百年战争期间，约翰·法斯托夫率英军于1425年攻占堡垒，法国军队于1439年收复。宗教战争时期，这里仍有军事意义。1604年，纪尧姆·富凯·德拉瓦雷讷购得旧堡，开始将其改造为宅邸，使中世纪据点获得新的用途。

english:
Saintes lies on the Charente, an ancient city whose churches bear witness to the rich Romanesque art of Saintonge. The abbey church of Notre-Dame, with its carved portal and distinctive bell tower, belonged to the Abbaye aux Dames, founded in 1047 as the first convent for women in Saintonge. Saint-Eutrope housed the tomb of the city’s first bishop and drew pilgrims on the road to Santiago de Compostela.

During the Hundred Years’ War the Charente became a political frontier: the fortified city on the left bank lay under the English king, while the abbey on the right bank remained under French authority. Later wars and fires damaged the convent, whose buildings were rebuilt under Abbess Françoise de Foix in the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese:
桑特坐落在夏朗德河畔，是一座古老城市。它的教堂见证了桑通日丰富的罗曼式艺术：带有雕刻门廊和独特钟楼的圣母修道院教堂属于女修道院，该院建于1047年，是桑通日第一座女修道院。圣厄特罗普教堂安放着城市首任主教的墓，吸引着前往圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉的朝圣者。

百年战争期间，夏朗德河成为政治边界：左岸的设防城区属于英格兰国王，右岸的修道院则仍在法国统治下。后来的战争与火灾损坏了女修道院，17世纪，女院长弗朗索瓦丝·德·富瓦主持重建了院舍。

sources.title: 17 - abbaye aux dames livret de visite.pdf

english:
Saipan is a high island in the southern Marianas, with a reef and lagoon along its western shore. Chamorro communities occupied the island long before the Spanish mission arrived in the archipelago in 1668. Its people resisted the missionaries and soldiers who sought to establish Spanish rule.

In 1670 two missionaries were killed on Saipan. In the years that followed, fighting spread across the Marianas as Spanish forces sought to suppress resistance. Fourteen years later the Spanish commander José de Quiroga invaded the island, defeated its defenders and established a church. Subsequent forced removals concentrated Chamorro survivors on Guam. In the early nineteenth century voyagers from the Caroline Islands settled Saipan, bringing their own seafaring traditions to an island reshaped by conquest and displacement.
simp_chinese:
塞班岛是马里亚纳群岛南部的高岛，西岸有珊瑚礁和潟湖。1668年西班牙传教团进入群岛之前，查莫罗社群已在岛上居住很久。岛民抵抗试图建立西班牙统治的传教士与士兵。

1670年，两名传教士在塞班岛遇害。此后数年，西班牙军队试图镇压抵抗，战火蔓延至马里亚纳各岛。十四年后，西班牙指挥官何塞·德·基罗加入侵该岛，击败守卫者并建立教堂。随后的强制迁移将幸存的查莫罗人集中到关岛。19世纪初，来自加罗林群岛的航行者在塞班定居，把自己的航海传统带到这座经历征服与迁徙的岛屿。

english: Saipurú lies in the eastern foothills of the Bolivian Andes, in a region long inhabited by Guaraní communities. Its Guaraní name has been associated with the bubbling of hot springs. Guaraní-speaking peoples reached the foothills in successive migrations from farther east, and their communities resisted Spanish advances during the colonial period. Wooded slopes and valleys separate this mountain frontier from the Chaco plains.
simp_chinese: 赛普鲁位于玻利维亚安第斯山东麓，是瓜拉尼社群长期居住的地区。其瓜拉尼语名称与温泉冒泡有关。使用瓜拉尼语的民族从更东面的地区分批迁至山麓，他们的社群在殖民时代抵抗西班牙人的推进。林木覆盖的山坡和谷地将这片山地边疆与查科平原分隔开来。

english: Saitama lies in the lowlands of northern Musashi, where rivers spread across the Kantō plain. The Narita family built Oshi Castle here in the fifteenth century and held it for generations. In 1590 Ishida Mitsunari besieged the castle during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's campaign against the Hōjō. He raised a long embankment and diverted water from the Tone and Arakawa rivers in an attempt to flood the defenders, leaving the district with a memorable battlefield landscape.
simp_chinese: 埼玉位于武藏北部低地，河流流经辽阔的关东平原。成田氏于十五世纪在此筑忍城，世代居守。1590年丰臣秀吉进攻北条氏时，石田三成围攻忍城，修筑长堤并引利根川、荒川之水，试图淹没守军，留下了著名的水攻遗迹。

english: Sakai lies on the northern plain of Echizen, where roads approach the border of Kaga. After Oda Nobunaga's forces subdued the Ikkō uprising in Echizen, Shibata Katsutoyo built Maruoka Castle in 1576. Its position mattered during the fighting against the Ikkō forces of neighboring Kaga. In 1624 Maruoka became a separate domain under the Honda family, and its castle remained the center of local rule.
simp_chinese: 坂井位于越前北部平原，通往加贺边界的道路经过这里。织田信长军队平定越前一向一揆后，柴田胜丰于1576年修筑丸冈城。邻近加贺的一向势力与越前交战时，城池的位置十分重要。1624年，丸冈在本多家治下成为独立藩，城池仍是地方统治的中心。

english: The Sakai are an indigenous people of the forested interior of eastern Sumatra, in the river country of Riau. Their ancestors lived among the forests and streams that lay within the sphere of the Malay kingdom of Siak Sri Indrapura. Relationships with the sultanate linked forest communities and their local leaders to the rulers of the river settlements, while the inland country retained its own customs and ways of life.
simp_chinese: 萨凯人是苏门答腊东部森林内陆的原住民，居住在廖内的河流地区。他们的祖先生活在锡亚克斯里英陀罗普拉马来王国势力范围内的森林与溪流之间。与苏丹国的关系使森林社群及其地方首领同河岸聚落的统治者相连，内陆地区同时保有自己的习俗与生活方式。

english: Sakaka lies among the oasis settlements of al-Jawf in northern Arabia. The hilltop fortress of Zaʿbal overlooks its palm groves and old wells, guarding a place on routes across the desert. South of the oasis stand the stone pillars of al-Rajajil, raised in the fourth millennium before our era. Their groups of tall stones bear witness to communities that occupied this dry country long before the fortified oasis took its later form.
simp_chinese: 塞卡卡位于北阿拉伯焦夫地区的绿洲聚落之间。扎巴勒山顶堡垒俯瞰椰枣林与古井，守护荒漠道路上的地点。绿洲以南矗立着拉贾吉勒石柱，建于公元前四千纪。一组组高石见证了久远以前居住在这片干燥地区的社群，时间远早于设防绿洲形成后来的面貌。

english: Sakambunje lies in the upper Kasai country, northwest of the Luao River. The Luao joins the Kasai near Luau, where another stream, the Cassepo, also enters the river. Across eastern Angola, rivers such as the Kasai flow between low banks and spread into marshy ground during the rains.
simp_chinese: 萨坎本杰位于卡赛河上游地区，在卢奥河西北方。卢奥河在卢奥附近汇入卡赛河，卡塞波河也在这一带注入卡赛河。安哥拉东部的卡赛河等河流两岸低平，雨季时水流漫出河岸，形成沼泽地。

sources.title: Lei 14 24 de 5 de Setembro Moxico Leste f596c0aa39.pdf

english: Sakao is an Austronesian language of the eastern side of Espiritu Santo in northern Vanuatu, around Hog Harbour and nearby islands. The coast faces the island of Ambae across the water, while forested mountains rise inland. In 1606 the expedition of Pedro Fernández de Quirós reached Santo and attempted a short-lived Spanish settlement at Big Bay to the north.
simp_chinese: 萨卡奥语是瓦努阿图北部桑托岛东侧的一种南岛语言，分布在霍格港及附近岛屿。海岸隔海面向奥巴岛，森林山地在内陆升起。1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的远征队抵达桑托岛，试图在北方大湾建立一处短暂的西班牙聚落。

english: Sakar is a volcanic island in the Vitiaz Strait between New Britain and New Guinea. The strait formed part of a maritime exchange region linking island and mainland communities. Archaeological evidence from the nearby Siassi Islands and Sio records a long history of pottery exchange.
simp_chinese: 萨卡尔是维提亚兹海峡中的一座火山岛，位于新不列颠与新几内亚之间。海峡是连接岛屿与大陆社群的海上交换地区的一部分。附近西亚西群岛和西奥的考古证据记录了悠久的陶器交换历史。

english:
Sakawyiniw names the Woodland Cree, the Sakawithiniwak, the largest Indigenous group in northern Alberta. Their country lies along the Athabasca River, and Calling Lake, a large lake in a bend of the river about sixty kilometres north of the town of Athabasca, sits within it. The local First Nations gave the lake its name after the sound of its ice cracking.

Before the eighteenth century the Woodland Cree's territory reached west of Hudson Bay and north as far as Churchill. By the 1700s they had become middlemen in trade with peoples farther west, and once they had acquired guns through that trade they expanded their territory, driving other tribes farther west and north. From about 1778 the Athabasca and Clearwater rivers, which run through their country, carried the fur trade from the Mackenzie River toward the Great Lakes.
simp_chinese:
萨卡维尼指北方森林中的伍兹克里人，即萨卡威提尼瓦克，是阿尔伯塔北部最大的原住民群体。他们的家园沿阿萨巴斯卡河展开，呼唤湖位于河流的一处大弯道中，在阿萨巴斯卡镇以北约六十公里。当地原住民为这座湖命名，因为冰面开裂时的声响仿佛在呼唤。

十八世纪以前，伍兹克里人的领地向西延伸到哈德逊湾以西，向北直抵丘吉尔。到十八世纪，他们成为与更西面民族交易的中间人；通过这一贸易获得枪械后，他们扩展了领地，把其他部族逐向西部和北部。约从1778年起，流经其领地的阿萨巴斯卡河与克利尔沃特河承载着从麦肯齐河通向五大湖的毛皮贸易。

english: West of the Lena, the central Yakutian lowlands are a country of forests, rivers and lakes underlain by permafrost. Larch dominates much of the northern forest, where the ground remains frozen beneath the surface and temperatures vary greatly between winter and summer. The Lena and its tributaries cross this immense landscape, carrying water northward from the interior toward the Arctic coast.
simp_chinese: 勒拿河以西的雅库特中部低地，森林、河流与湖泊之下广布永久冻土。落叶松是北方森林的重要树种，地表之下的土壤长年冻结，冬夏气温差异极大。勒拿河及其支流穿过这片辽阔土地，将内陆水流送往北方的北极海岸。

english:
Saki, also written Shaki, lies in northern Yoruba country on the savanna frontier of the Oyo Empire. Farmland, grazing land and routes linked the town with neighbouring communities, and its markets drew traders from the forest and from the north.

During the early modern centuries the Oyo Empire extended its influence through military organisation, tribute and trade. Local towns kept their own institutions within this system. Islamic influence arrived through commerce alongside older religious traditions. In the early nineteenth century Oyo weakened, warfare spread across the northern frontier, and the shifting alliances placed heavy pressure on communities such as Saki.
simp_chinese:
萨基又写作沙基，位于约鲁巴北部，处在奥约帝国的草原边疆。草原与耕地支持农业和交换，道路把城镇同邻近社群相连，市场则吸引来自森林地带和北方的商人。

近代早期，奥约帝国通过军事组织、贡赋和贸易扩大影响。地方城镇在这一体系中保留自身制度，伊斯兰影响通过商业进入，与既有宗教传统并存。十九世纪初奥约衰弱，北部边疆战事扩大，不断变化的联盟给萨基等社群带来沉重压力。

english: The Sakurabiat, also known as Mekens, are an Indigenous people of the Mequéns River country east of the Guaporé. Their language belongs to the Tupari family, and their homeland lies among forest streams near the headwaters of the Mequéns and Verde. Since the seventeenth century, the name Mequens has been applied to several related groups in this region, rather than to a single community alone.
simp_chinese: 萨库拉比亚特人也被称为梅肯斯人，是瓜波雷河以东梅肯斯河地区的原住民族。他们的语言属于图帕里语系，家园位于梅肯斯河和韦尔迪河源头附近的森林溪流之间。自十七世纪以来，梅肯斯一名被用来称呼这一地区若干有关联的群体，而非仅指一个社区。

english:
Sakitawak, “where the waters meet,” is the Cree name for Île-à-la-Crosse and its lake on the upper Churchill River. A peninsula reaches into the broad water where routes from the Beaver and Churchill rivers come together. Cree and Dene people gathered and travelled through this lake country long before the arrival of trading posts.

In 1776 Thomas Frobisher established a post on the lake. Its position made it a centre of the northern fur trade: provisions could come up the Beaver River from the plains, while the route north crossed the Methye Portage towards Athabasca. Rival traders followed, and the Hudson's Bay Company sought a foothold in 1799. After its union with the North West Company in 1821, Île-à-la-Crosse became the headquarters of the district. A Métis community grew around the lake and the relationships formed through trade.
simp_chinese:
萨基塔瓦克意为“水流汇合之处”，是丘吉尔河上游伊勒阿拉克罗斯及其湖泊的克里语名称。半岛伸入宽阔水域，比弗河和丘吉尔河的路线在附近交会。商站出现以前，克里人和德内人已经在湖区聚会、旅行。

1776年，托马斯·弗罗比舍在湖边设立商站。这里很快成为北方毛皮贸易中心：草原上的补给可沿比弗河运来，向北则可越过梅西转运道前往阿萨巴斯卡。竞争者相继到来，哈得孙湾公司也在1799年试图立足。1821年与西北公司合并后，伊勒阿拉克罗斯成为该地区的总部。湖边及贸易形成的社会关系中，梅蒂斯社群逐渐发展起来。

english:
Sakiwasipi, the Miami name for the St Joseph River, means “outlet river.” Flowing through southern Michigan and northern Indiana to Lake Michigan, it formed part of an extensive Indigenous waterway network. A short portage near South Bend connected it to the Kankakee and Illinois rivers, opening a route toward the Mississippi. Another portage linked its headwaters to the Maumee watershed and Lake Erie.

In 1675 Indigenous guides led Jacques Marquette along this route to Lake Michigan. Four years later the French explorer La Salle built Fort Miami at the river mouth and travelled upstream to the Kankakee portage. The French established Fort St Joseph in 1691 near the crossing of the Old Sauk Trail, joining a network already used by Indigenous travellers and traders.
simp_chinese:
萨基瓦西比是迈阿密人对圣约瑟夫河的称呼，意为“出口之河”。河流穿过密歇根南部与印第安纳北部，注入密歇根湖，是原住民广大水路网络的一部分。南本德附近一段短暂的陆上搬舟通道将它连接到坎卡基河和伊利诺伊河，通向密西西比河。另一条搬舟通道连接河流源头与莫米河流域及伊利湖。

1675年，原住民向导带领雅克·马凯特沿这条路线抵达密歇根湖。四年后，拉萨尔在河口修筑迈阿密堡，随后逆流而上，前往坎卡基河的搬舟通道。1691年，法国人在古索克小径的渡河处附近建立圣约瑟夫堡，加入原住民旅人和商人早已使用的交通网络。

english: Sakchu lies in the mountains near the Yalu River on Korea's northwestern frontier. It was one of the strongpoints linked by Koryŏ's great frontier wall, completed in 1044 after wars with the Khitan. Under Joseon, the district's boundaries were reorganised in 1394, and Sakchu was raised to the rank of a protectorate in 1413. Forts, passes and beacon stations reflected its continuing role in border defence.
simp_chinese: 朔州位于朝鲜西北边境鸭绿江附近的山地。高丽与契丹交战后修建千里长城，于1044年完工，朔州是长城所连接的据点之一。朝鲜王朝于1394年调整当地疆界，1413年将朔州升为都护府。城镇、关隘与烽燧显示出它持续承担的边防职责。

english: The Ulakhan-Sakkyryr rises as the Tumara from a small lake in the Orulgan Range, part of the Verkhoyansk mountains. It crosses the high country and enters the Bytantay through several channels. The Bytantay then joins the Yana on its way north to the Laptev Sea. Forested valleys and mountain ridges surround these rivers, far inland from the Arctic coast.
simp_chinese: 乌拉汗—萨克雷尔河以图马拉河之名发源于奥鲁尔甘岭的一座小湖，奥鲁尔甘岭属于上扬斯克山脉。河流穿过高地，以多条水道汇入贝坦泰河。贝坦泰河又注入亚纳河，向北流往拉普捷夫海。森林河谷与山岭环绕这些河流，距离北极海岸遥远。

english: The Sakma runs through the steppe east of the Volga to join the Great Irgiz. Its shallow valley cuts across the open land near the later settlement of Gorny, carrying water north toward the larger river. The Great Irgiz in turn flows west to the Volga, joining the pastures of the interior to the river corridor where settlements grew in the eighteenth century. Along the Sakma, the winding stream and its banks formed part of this dry steppe landscape.
simp_chinese: 萨克马河流经伏尔加河以东的草原，汇入大伊尔吉兹河。浅河谷穿过后来戈尔内聚落附近的开阔土地，将水流向北带往较大的河流。大伊尔吉兹河继而向西流入伏尔加河，将内陆牧场与十八世纪聚落逐渐发展的河流地带相连。萨克马河蜿蜒的河道与两岸是这片干燥草原地貌的一部分。

english: Sakti was the seat of a small Gond-ruled state in the eastern Chhattisgarh country. Its founding is attributed to two brothers, Hari and Gujar, whom tradition describes as soldiers of the raja of Sambalpur. Their descendants ruled from Sakti as a local dynasty. The surrounding country is watered by the Mahanadi and its tributaries, with forested land and agricultural settlements extending across the interior between Ratanpur and Sambalpur.
simp_chinese: 瑟格蒂是恰蒂斯加尔东部一个贡德人统治的小国的驻地。传说其创建者是哈里与古贾尔两兄弟，他们曾是桑巴尔普尔罗阇的士兵。两人的后代以瑟格蒂为中心形成地方王朝。摩诃那迪河及其支流流经周围地区，拉特纳普尔与桑巴尔普尔之间的内陆分布着森林和农业聚落。

english: Saku occupies a high basin in eastern Shinano, crossed by the Chikuma River. At its western edge stands Komoro, where a castle town took shape in the turbulent closing years of the sixteenth century. Sengoku Hidehisa entered Komoro in 1590 and rebuilt its castle; the town later served travellers on the Hokkoku Kaidō, the road connecting the Nakasendō with the provinces on the Sea of Japan.
simp_chinese: 佐久位于信浓东部的高原盆地，千曲川从中流过。盆地西缘的小诸在十六世纪末的乱世中逐渐形成城下町。仙石秀久于1590年入主小诸并修筑城郭；此后城镇又成为北国街道上的旅人落脚之处，这条道路连接中山道与日本海沿岸诸国。

english:
The Sakwatamau River joins the Athabasca near the mouth of the McLeod, where waters from the wooded foothills meet the larger river. Downstream, the Athabasca turns through northern forest towards its great lake. This stretch of river became part of a route connecting the interior with the mountain passes and the Pacific watershed.

In 1823 the Hudson's Bay Company built Fort Assiniboine farther downstream on the Athabasca River. Two years later a road to Fort Edmonton linked it to the North Saskatchewan River. Goods could be carried overland between the two posts and transferred to canoes for the long journey upriver towards Jasper House and the mountain passes. The new route gave the company a shorter way across western North America.
simp_chinese:
萨夸塔毛河在麦克劳德河口附近汇入阿萨巴斯卡河，森林山麓的水流在此与大河会合。下游的阿萨巴斯卡河穿过北方森林，流向广阔的同名湖泊。这段河流后来成为连接内陆、山口与太平洋流域的路线之一。

1823年，哈得孙湾公司在阿萨巴斯卡河下游建起阿西尼博因堡。两年后，通往埃德蒙顿堡的道路将它与北萨斯喀彻温河连接起来。货物可在两座商站之间经陆路搬运，再转到独木舟上，逆流前往贾斯珀屋和山口。这条新路线为公司提供了横穿北美西部的较短道路。

english:
Sakya takes its name from the pale earth of the hills in western Tsang. Here Khön Könchok Gyalpo founded a monastery in 1073, giving his family and a major school of Tibetan Buddhism the name Sakya. The fortified southern monastery, built across the river under the direction of Chögyal Phagpa in 1268, became a great religious and political centre. Its halls housed scriptures, images and paintings as well as the seat of the Sakya hierarchs.

Sakya's rulers gained authority over Tibet through their relationship with the Mongol court. Phagpa served Kublai Khan as religious preceptor and devised a script intended for the languages of the empire. At the start of the fourteenth century the Sakya administration still governed much of Tibet under Yuan patronage, but its power was challenged by rising regional families. In 1354 Jangchub Gyaltsen of Phagmodru captured Sakya, ending its pre-eminence as the Mongols' governing centre in central Tibet. The monastery and its scholarly tradition nevertheless endured beyond the fall of its political supremacy.
simp_chinese:
萨迦因藏地西部山坡上的灰白色土壤而得名。1073年，昆·衮却杰布在此建寺，此后其家族和藏传佛教的一个重要教派都以萨迦为名。1268年，八思巴下令在河对岸兴建设防的南寺，形成宏大的宗教与政治中心。殿堂内收藏经文、佛像和壁画，也是萨迦法王的驻锡地。

萨迦统治者凭借与蒙古宫廷的关系取得对西藏的权力。八思巴担任忽必烈的宗教导师，并创制旨在书写帝国诸种语言的文字。十四世纪初，萨迦政权仍在元朝支持下治理西藏广大地区，但地方家族的兴起不断挑战其权威。1354年，帕竹的绛曲坚赞攻占萨迦，结束了它作为蒙古在西藏中部统治中心的显赫地位。政治优势消失之后，寺院及其学术传统仍延续下来。

english:
Sala owes its importance to the silver-bearing rock of Västmanland. For centuries miners worked the deposits at Salberget, where a village grew beside the mine. Silver brought the crown a valuable source of revenue, but extracting it required shafts, furnaces and an elaborate system to remove water from the workings.

In 1624 Gustav II Adolf founded a new town some distance from the mine and ordered the old mining village emptied. Georg Grissbach, brought from the Harz, took charge of improving the workings in 1628. A canal completed in 1640 supplied water power for machinery, and new shafts reached rich ore at greater depth. The great shaft named for Queen Christina was begun in 1650; after more than a decade of sinking it reached deposits some 190 metres below the surface. The mining landscape depended on dams and channels as well as the labour of miners and those who supplied fuel.

In 1736 fire destroyed almost all of Sala, including its church and town hall. Reconstruction took years, while the mine itself faced the difficulties of declining production. Miners increasingly used gunpowder alongside the older method of heating and breaking the rock, and the works continued to search for ore at different levels. Nevertheless its shafts and waterworks remained a striking testament to the resources and effort devoted to Swedish silver.
simp_chinese:
萨拉的重要性源于西曼兰的含银岩石。几个世纪以来，矿工在萨尔山开采矿藏，矿旁形成村庄。银矿为王室提供宝贵收入，但开采需要竖井、冶炼炉和从矿井排水的复杂设施。

1624年，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫在距矿场一段距离处建立新城，命令旧矿村居民迁出。来自哈尔茨的格奥尔格·格里斯巴赫于1628年负责改善矿务。1640年完工的运河为机械提供水力，新竖井则深入地下开采富矿。以克里斯蒂娜女王命名的大竖井于1650年开工，经过十余年掘进，在地下约190米处到达矿藏。矿业景观依靠水坝和水渠，也依靠矿工及燃料供应者的劳动。

1736年，大火几乎毁灭整座萨拉，包括教堂和市政厅。重建耗时多年，矿场本身也面临产量下降的困难。矿工日益使用火药，配合加热岩石再破碎的旧方法，矿场继续在不同深度寻找矿脉。尽管如此，竖井与水利设施仍见证了瑞典为获取银矿投入的资源和努力。

english: Sala lies on the eastern side of the Vallo di Diano, where the Apennine slopes rise above a broad inland valley. An old castle crowns a hill above the settlement, recalling its place in the county of Marsico and the lands of the Sanseverino family. In 1497 Frederick of Aragon besieged the castle during the conflict with the rebellious prince of Salerno. The stronghold was destroyed after the siege, leaving its ruins above the town.
simp_chinese: 萨拉位于迪亚诺谷东侧，亚平宁山坡从宽广的内陆谷地向上升起。古堡遗迹冠于镇上山丘，让人想起这里曾属于马尔西科伯国和桑塞韦里诺家族领地。1497年，阿拉贡的费德里科在与反叛的萨莱诺亲王交战时围攻城堡。堡垒围城后被毁，遗址仍俯瞰着镇子。

english: The Laguna Salada occupies a low desert basin west of the Colorado River delta. Its name, “salt lagoon,” reflects the deposits left as water evaporates from the enclosed depression. At times Colorado River floods reached this basin, spreading water across the desert floor. The surrounding country forms part of the homeland of Yuman-speaking peoples whose routes connected the river, delta and nearby mountains.
simp_chinese: 萨拉达潟湖位于科罗拉多河三角洲以西的低洼沙漠盆地。“盐潟湖”的名称反映了封闭洼地中水分蒸发后留下的盐分。科罗拉多河洪水有时会抵达盆地，将水铺展在沙漠地面上。周围土地是说尤曼语民族的故土之一，其路线连接河流、三角洲与附近山地。

english:
Salaga was a great market town of Gonja, where traders from the forest country met merchants from the northern savanna. Gonja, Hausa, Wangara, Dagomba and other communities gathered there, giving it a varied population and a reputation that earned it the name “Timbuktu of the south.” Kola from the south traveled through the market toward Hausaland, alongside cloth, animals and other goods.

Salaga succeeded the older Gonja market of Kafaba after the seventeenth century and became especially important in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. Wars with Kong helped turn Asante trade toward the route through Salaga. Its market also dealt in enslaved people, some of whom were carried south to the Atlantic coast. The traffic brought wealth to traders and rulers while exposing captives to separation, forced journeys and sale far from home.
simp_chinese:
萨拉加是贡贾的一座大市场城镇，森林地区的商人与北方草原的商旅在此相遇。贡贾人、豪萨人、旺加拉人、达贡巴人等在此聚居，城镇因人口与贸易多样而有“南方通布图”之称。南方出产的可乐果经过市场运往豪萨兰，同行的货物还有布匹、牲畜等。

十七世纪之后，萨拉加接替较早的贡贾市场卡法巴，十八、十九世纪时尤其重要。与孔的战争促使阿散蒂将贸易转向经过萨拉加的道路。市场也买卖被奴役者，其中一些人被带往南方大西洋海岸。人口贩运给商人和统治者带来财富，却使俘虏被迫离散、远行，并在远离家乡的地方遭到出卖。

sources.title: TRADE PATTERNS IN GHANA AT THE BEGINNING.pdf

english:
Salagiri is the mountain fortress of Salher in Baglana, high in the Sahyadri range. Together with nearby Mulher it guarded the routes between the Deccan and Gujarat. The steep approach made the fort difficult to attack, and its position gave it a prominent part in the struggles for the hill country.

The Mughals seized Salher and Mulher from the local Rathod rulers in 1638. Shivaji’s forces later took Salher, and in 1672 a Mughal army besieged it. Maratha commanders relieved the fort and defeated the besiegers in a major battle, then captured Mulher as well. Salher remained a contested stronghold during the long wars between the Mughals and Marathas, its height and approaches giving it enduring military value in the struggle for western India.
simp_chinese:
萨拉吉里即巴格拉纳的萨尔赫尔山堡，高踞萨希亚德里山脉。它与附近的穆尔赫尔共同守卫德干和古吉拉特之间的道路。陡峭的进路使堡垒难以攻取，地理位置则使它在山地争夺中占据重要地位。

1638年，莫卧儿人从当地拉索尔统治者手中夺取萨尔赫尔与穆尔赫尔。希瓦吉的军队后来夺下萨尔赫尔，1672年莫卧儿军队又围攻此堡。马拉塔将领解围并在大战中击败围攻者，随后又攻取穆尔赫尔。在莫卧儿与马拉塔长期战争中，萨尔赫尔始终是争夺的要塞，山势和进路使其具有持久的军事价值。

english: Salah Point lies on the low southern coast of New Guinea, facing the Arafura Sea. Rivers and tidal channels shape this shore. In 1606 Luis Váez de Torres sailed along parts of southern New Guinea and through the strait to its south, a region already inhabited by coastal communities.
simp_chinese: 萨拉赫角位于新几内亚南部低岸，面向阿拉弗拉海。河流和潮汐水道塑造了这片海岸。1606年，路易斯·瓦埃斯·德·托雷斯沿新几内亚南岸部分地区航行，穿过岛屿南方的海峡；沿岸社群早已在这一地区生活。

english: Salair grew around silver-bearing mines in the low hills of the Salair Ridge. The prospector Dmitry Popov found the deposit in 1781 by following traces of older workings, and mining began the following year. Further mines were opened in 1786 and 1798. A silver smelter was built nearby in 1792–94, linking the ores of Salair with the mining and metallurgical enterprises of the Altai region.
simp_chinese: 萨拉伊尔兴起于萨拉伊尔山脊低丘中的银矿附近。1781年，探矿者德米特里·波波夫沿古代采掘遗迹发现矿床，次年开始开采。1786年和1798年又开设了新矿。1792—1794年，附近建成一座炼银厂，使萨拉伊尔的矿石与阿尔泰地区的采矿、冶金事业联系起来。

english:
Set on a rocky bluff above the Tormes in the western Meseta, Salamanca was an old Celtiberian and Roman town that the Christian kingdoms repopulated under Alfonso VI in 1085 as part of the great resettlement of the lands between the Duero and Tagus. The decisive transformation came in 1218 when King Alfonso IX of León established a #italic Studium Generale#! here, and the school he founded grew with extraordinary speed into one of the four great universities of Christendom alongside Bologna, Paris, and Oxford, its #italic licentia ubique docendi#! confirmed by Pope Alexander IV in 1255. Its scholars in canon law and theology soon rivaled those of the older European #italic studia#!, and by the early 14th century Salamanca was the principal center of intellectual life in the Castilian realm.

The university's greatest days still lay ahead. Its masters met to weigh Columbus's plans before his first voyage, and in 1492 Antonio de Nebrija published his grammar of Castilian, the first study of any Western European language other than Latin. In the 16th century the city reached its height, with some 24,000 inhabitants and about 6,500 students enrolling each year around 1580. Its Dominican teachers, led by Francisco de Vitoria and remembered as the School of Salamanca, rebuilt the idea of natural law around the new conquests and defended the rights of the peoples of the Americas against the colonists. Then Salamanca shared the decline of the Castilian Meseta, falling to 12,000 people by 1651, and only the revival of the 18th century finished its long-stalled New Cathedral and gave it the great Baroque Plaza Mayor of 1729.
simp_chinese:
萨拉曼卡坐落在梅塞塔高原西部托尔梅斯河上方的岩石峭壁之上，是一座古老的凯尔特伊比利亚和罗马城镇。1085年，在阿方索六世治下，基督教王国在杜罗河和塔霍河间大规模迁移人口，许多人被迁至萨拉曼卡。决定性的转变发生在1218年，当时莱昂国王阿方索九世在此建立了一所#italic 综合学院#!，这所大学后来以惊人的速度发展成为基督教世界四大大学之一，与博洛尼亚、巴黎和牛津齐名。1255年，教宗亚历山大四世确认了其#italic 任教许可#!。这所大学的教会法与神学方面的学者已经能与欧洲更古老的学府相匹敌；至14世纪初，萨拉曼卡已成为卡斯蒂利亚王国的主要知识中心。

这所大学最辉煌的时代还在后面。哥伦布首航之前，大学的学者曾聚议他的计划；1492年，安东尼奥·德·内夫里哈出版了卡斯蒂利亚语语法，这是西欧第一部研究拉丁语以外语言规则的著作。16世纪，萨拉曼卡臻于极盛，约有2.4万居民，1580年前后每年入学的学生约有6500人。以弗朗西斯科·德·维多利亚为首的多明我会学者，后人称之为萨拉曼卡学派，面对新征服的土地重新阐发自然法，为美洲各民族的权利辩护，批评殖民者的暴行。此后萨拉曼卡随卡斯蒂利亚梅塞塔高原的城市一同衰落，到1651年人口降至1.2万；直到18世纪复兴，停工近百年的新主教座堂才告完工，宏伟的巴洛克式主广场也在1729年落成。

english:
The Bahr Salamat gathers waters from the channels and floodwaters of the Bahr Azoum before flowing toward the Chari. Its floodplain holds seasonal pools as well as grasslands, supporting fish, waterbirds and grazing animals. In the dry season, parts of the Salamat's intricate network shrink to isolated pools.

The later city of Am Timan lies here.
simp_chinese:
萨拉马特河汇集阿祖姆河的支汊和洪水，继而流向沙里河。洪泛平原上既有季节性水塘，也有草地，为鱼类、水鸟和食草动物提供栖息地。旱季到来时，萨拉马特河错综复杂的水网有些地方只剩下孤立的水塘。

后来的安提曼即位于此地。

english: Salameh lies in the Khaf district of eastern Khorasan, where a historic pavilion and an old dam recall the wealth and waterworks of the oasis settlements. The stone dam stands northeast of the village and regulated water for the fields downstream. Attributed to the Timurid period, it was repaired in later centuries. Older geographical writings knew the place under a form of the name Salumad, preserved in the history of Sistan.
simp_chinese: 萨拉梅位于呼罗珊东部的哈夫地区，古亭和水坝令人想起绿洲聚落的财富与水利工程。石坝坐落在村庄东北，为下游田地调节水流；它被认为建于帖木儿时期，后世曾多次修缮。较早的地理著作以萨卢马德一类名称记载此地，《锡斯坦史》也保存了这一地名。

english:
Salamiyya lies on the edge of the Syrian steppe east of Hama, between the cultivated Orontes valley and the desert. In the ninth century it was a residence of early Ismaili imams and a centre from which the Ismaili mission was directed before the rise of the Fatimid caliphate. Its position made it a meeting place of settled and pastoral country, but also exposed it to raids and the changing fortunes of the roads across the steppe.

The town gradually lost importance under Ottoman rule. Travellers in the early nineteenth century found Salamiyya deserted and in ruins, its old fort standing among abandoned buildings. The loss of protection against raids contributed to the decline of settlement in the district. Yet the town's earlier connection with the Ismaili imams remained part of its history, long after its inhabitants had left the once important centre.
simp_chinese:
萨拉米耶位于哈马以东的叙利亚草原边缘，介于奥龙特河谷耕地与荒漠之间。九世纪，这里是早期伊斯玛仪派伊玛目的驻地，也是法蒂玛哈里发国兴起前组织传教活动的中心。城镇处在定居地与牧区交界，却也容易受到袭扰，并随草原道路的兴衰而变化。

奥斯曼统治下，萨拉米耶逐渐失去重要地位。十九世纪初的旅行者发现这里已无人居住，旧堡垒矗立在废弃建筑之间。缺乏抵御袭击的保护，是地区聚落衰落的原因之一。尽管昔日的重要中心已被居民离弃，它与早期伊斯玛仪派伊玛目的联系仍是当地历史的一部分。

english: Salaspils lies on the Daugava upstream from Riga. Its name means Island Castle, recalling a Livonian stronghold on Mārtiņsala, where a Christian church stood by 1186. In 1380 the Livonian Order built a new castle on the mainland, around which a settlement grew. Both were destroyed during the Livonian War in 1577. The place was known in German as Kircholm, and in 1605 it gave its name to a great battle. There a Polish–Lithuanian army defeated a much larger Swedish force near the church of St George, in one of the most striking victories of the Polish–Swedish wars.
simp_chinese: 萨拉斯皮尔斯位于里加上游的道加瓦河畔。其名称意为「岛上城堡」，令人想起马丁萨拉岛上的利沃尼亚人堡寨；1186年前，岛上已有一座基督教堂。1380年，利沃尼亚骑士团在大陆上建造新城堡，周围发展出聚落，两者均在1577年利沃尼亚战争期间遭毁。这里的德语名为基尔霍尔姆，并因1605年的一场大战闻名：波兰立陶宛军队在圣乔治教堂附近击败人数多得多的瑞典军队，取得两国战争中一次引人注目的胜利。

english:
Salavata, or Chilaw, lies beside a lagoon on Sri Lanka’s northwestern coast. Fishing communities and traders used its sheltered waters, while the nearby Munneswaram temple drew worshippers to a shrine of Shiva, known there as Munneswaram and accompanied by a shrine to the goddess. The temple belongs to a region where Sinhala and Tamil communities met along the coast.

Portuguese attacks damaged the shrine in the sixteenth century. Worship continued despite destruction and political change, and in 1753 the Kandyan king Kirti Sri Rajasinha supported its reconstruction and granted land for its upkeep. The temple’s later history shows the endurance of a Hindu sacred place of worship in a coastal country contested by European powers and the inland kingdom of Kandy.
simp_chinese:
萨拉瓦塔即奇洛，位于斯里兰卡西北海岸的潟湖旁。渔民社群和商人利用受庇护的水域，附近的蒙内斯瓦拉姆神庙则吸引信徒前来供奉湿婆，神庙中还设有女神的神殿。这座神庙所在的海岸地区是僧伽罗与泰米尔社群相遇之地。

十六世纪葡萄牙人的袭击损坏了神庙。尽管经历破坏与政治变动，礼拜仍然延续。1753年，康提国王吉尔蒂·斯里·拉贾辛哈支持重建神庙，并赠地供其维护。这座印度教圣所在欧洲势力与内陆康提王国争夺的海岸地区得以延续。

english: The Salaverry coast lies beside the Moche valley on Peru’s northern Pacific shore. Cold coastal waters support abundant fish, while rivers bring water from the Andes to the otherwise dry plain. Nearby, the great adobe city of Chan Chan was the capital of the Chimú kingdom before its conquest by the Incas in the fifteenth century. Its inhabitants drew on the resources of irrigated fields and the sea, joining coastal and inland life.
simp_chinese: 萨拉韦里海岸位于秘鲁北部太平洋沿岸，毗邻莫切河谷。寒冷近海养育丰富的鱼类，河流则将安第斯山脉的水带到原本干旱的平原。附近巨大的土坯城市昌昌曾是奇穆王国的都城，直到十五世纪被印加人征服。居民利用灌溉田地和海洋的资源，将沿海与内陆生活联系起来。

sources.title: 2019 Storke Peru Oryan & Myers Field Guide.pdf

english: Salay lies beside the Irrawaddy south of Pagan, in the dry country of central Burma. It grew as a satellite of the Pagan kingdom in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries and remained a place of Buddhist learning and worship. Old monuments recall its ties to the royal capital upstream. Among the town's revered images is the Man Buddha, housed in a temple at Salay. The river connects this religious centre with the settlements and shrines of the wider Irrawaddy valley.
simp_chinese: 色礼位于蒲甘以南的伊洛瓦底江畔，地处缅甸中部干燥地带。十二至十三世纪，它作为蒲甘王国的卫星城发展起来，后来仍是佛教学习与礼拜之地。古老建筑见证了它与上游王都的联系。当地寺庙供奉的曼佛像，是城中受人尊崇的佛像之一。江水将这个宗教中心与伊洛瓦底江流域更广阔的村落和圣所连接起来。

english: Salban belongs to the Sakha country of the middle Lena, where the great river crosses the Central Yakutian Lowland. Its broad valley and islands contrast with the forests beyond the banks. The Lena flows north through a land of extreme seasonal change: long, bitter winters give way to a short summer and the river's annual release from ice.
simp_chinese: 萨尔班位于勒拿河中游的萨哈人地区，大河在此穿过中雅库特低地。宽阔的河谷和河中岛屿与岸外的森林形成鲜明对比。勒拿河向北流经季节变化极端的土地：漫长酷寒的冬季过后，短暂的夏天到来，河上的冰封也随之消解。

english: Sol Chaget is the Tanana name associated with the Salcha River, a tributary of the Tanana in interior Alaska. The Salchaket people occupied this part of the middle Tanana country, with neighbouring groups using adjacent territories along the river. Their language belonged to the Athabascan family and is often described as Middle Tanana. The river and its tributaries formed part of a landscape of fishing places and hunting grounds, connected by seasonal travel to other communities of the Tanana valley.
simp_chinese: 索尔查格特是与萨尔查河相联系的塔纳纳语名称。这条河是阿拉斯加内陆塔纳纳河的一条支流。萨尔查凯特人居住在塔纳纳河中游的这一带，邻近族群则使用沿河相接的土地。他们的语言属于阿萨巴斯卡语系，常被称为中塔纳纳语。河流和支流是渔场与猎地构成的地景的一部分，季节性的旅行将这里与塔纳纳河谷其他社群相连。

english: Saldaña stands beside the Carrión beneath the castle of its medieval counts. The fortress was already recorded in the tenth century, when the Banu Gómez held power in this part of the kingdom of León. The town's market remained a focus for the surrounding countryside. In 1453 John II authorised the Marquis of Santillana to hold a fair at Saldaña, adding to the commercial life gathered around the church of San Miguel and the nearby squares.
simp_chinese: 萨尔达尼亚坐落在卡里翁河畔，中世纪伯爵的城堡俯瞰镇子。十世纪已有关于堡垒的记载，当时巴努戈梅斯家族掌握莱昂王国这一地区的权力。当地集市长期是周边乡村的中心。1453年，胡安二世准许桑蒂利亚纳侯爵在萨尔达尼亚举办集市，进一步丰富了围绕圣米格尔教堂及附近广场展开的商业生活。

english: Saldanha Bay offers a broad, sheltered anchorage on the coast north of the Cape of Good Hope. Khoikhoi communities lived and grazed livestock in the surrounding country, where visiting ships sought provisions. In 1601 the Dutch navigator Joris van Spilbergen applied the name Saldanha to this bay, confusing it with the anchorage farther south that Portuguese sailors had previously called by that name. The older Saldanha anchorage became known as Table Bay.
simp_chinese: 萨尔达尼亚湾位于好望角以北，提供宽阔而避风的锚地。科伊科伊社群在周围土地上生活、放牧，来访船只也在此寻求补给。1601年，荷兰航海家约里斯·范斯皮尔贝亨误将这个海湾认作葡萄牙水手先前称为萨尔达尼亚的锚地，并把该名称用于此处；原先的锚地后来称作桌湾。

english: Saldé lies at the eastern end of the Île à Morfil, where branches of the Senegal River meet. Its position made the nearby ford a place of importance when the waters fell. After the Islamic revolution in Futa Toro, the first almamy, Abdul Kader Kane, ordered inhabitants of Pété to guard the crossing against raids from the north. A settlement grew again beside the confluence, known as the salndu, from which Saldé takes its name.
simp_chinese: 萨尔代位于象牙岛东端，塞内加尔河的支流在此汇合。河水退去时，附近的浅滩成为重要渡口。富塔托罗伊斯兰革命后，首任阿尔马米阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔·卡内命令佩泰的居民守卫渡口，防备来自北方的袭击。聚落在河流交汇处重新发展，当地称汇合处为“萨尔恩杜”，萨尔代的名字即由此而来。

english: Saldus lies on the Ciecere, a tributary of the Venta in Courland. A Curonian stronghold stood beside Lake Saldus until the thirteenth century, and the name appears in records from that period. Under the Livonian Order the surrounding district was among the possessions administered from Kuldīga. A wooden church dedicated to St John was recorded here in 1461, a sign of the religious institutions established after the conquest of the Curonian lands. The later settlement grew around this old church and the countryside of the Ciecere valley.
simp_chinese: 萨尔杜斯位于库尔兰的切采雷河畔，这条河是文塔河的支流。萨尔杜斯湖旁的一座库尔人堡寨延续至十三世纪，地名也见于该时期的记载。在利沃尼亚骑士团统治下，周围地区由库尔迪加管理。1461年的文书提到一座献给圣若望的木教堂，显示库尔人土地遭征服后这里建立的宗教机构。后来的聚落围绕这座古老教堂和切采雷河谷的乡村发展。

english:
Set on the northern bank of the Bou Regreg where the river meets the Atlantic, Salé was one of the foremost ports of medieval Morocco, its merchants trading the grain, wool, leather, and wax of the interior with the Christian cities of Iberia and Italy and with the markets of the Mediterranean. The town suffered a devastating sack by a Castilian fleet in 1260, after which the Marinid sultans rebuilt and fortified it, adorning it with a fine congregational mosque and a celebrated madrasa. At the beginning of the 14th century, Salé stood as a wealthy and cultured trading city, its harbor crowded with the shipping of two seas and its scholars and jurists lending it a reputation for learning to rival the great inland cities.

In the early 17th century Salé won a new and more fearsome fame. Moriscos driven out of Spain, the first of them from Hornachos in Extremadura, settled across the river in the old medina of Rabat, which the English called New Salé, and made the mouth of the Bou Regreg the busiest corsair harbour on the Atlantic coast. European renegades joined them, a Dutch captain among the most famous, and the Salé rovers ranged across the Atlantic and deep into the Mediterranean. In 1627 the exiles drove out the sultan's governor and set up a virtually independent republic under a council of notables, which Spanish and French fleets bombarded in 1628 and 1629. Quarrels between the newcomers and the old townsfolk weakened it, and after 1640 a Berber Sufi lodge from the upper Moulouya valley held sway over both banks, until in 1668 the Alaouite sultan Moulay al-Rashid defeated it and ended the corsairs' independence.
simp_chinese:
塞拉坐落在布赖格赖格河与海洋交汇处的北岸，发展成为中世纪摩洛哥最重要的港口之一。其商贾将内陆的谷物、羊毛、皮革和蜂蜡运往伊比利亚和意大利的基督教城市及地中海市场进行贸易。1260年，该城遭到卡斯蒂利亚舰队的毁灭性洗劫，此后马林王朝苏丹重建并加强了城防，为其增添了一座华美的清真寺和一所享有盛誉的伊斯兰学校。至14世纪初，塞拉已是一座富裕且文明的贸易城市，港口中挤满了来往于两海之间的船只，其学者和法学家为其赢得了可与内陆大城市相媲美的学术声誉。

17世纪初，塞拉有了一种更令人生畏的新名声。被西班牙驱逐的摩里斯科人，最早一批来自埃斯特雷马杜拉的奥纳乔斯，在河对岸拉巴特的老城住了下来，英国人管那里叫“新塞拉”；他们把布赖格赖格河口变成了大西洋沿岸最繁忙的海盗港。叛教的欧洲人也加入进来，其中最出名的是一位荷兰船长，塞拉海盗的船只出没于整个大西洋，并深入地中海。1627年，流亡者赶走苏丹的总督，建立起一个由显贵议事会治理、几乎独立的共和国，1628年和1629年，西班牙和法国舰队先后前来炮击。新来者与塞拉本地居民的争执削弱了共和国，1640年后，来自穆卢耶河上游的一个柏柏尔苏非道团控制了两岸，直到1668年，阿拉维王朝苏丹穆莱·拉希德击败他们，结束了这批海盗的独立。

english: The Salish and Pend d'Oreille homelands embraced the valleys of the Flathead and Clark Fork rivers and extended east across the mountains. Their people travelled between fishing places, plant grounds and hunting country, including the bison plains beyond the divide. On the Clark Fork, David Thompson established Saleesh House for the North West Company in 1809. The post brought the fur trade into a country already connected by Indigenous routes and relationships, and Thompson spent the winter there before returning north.
simp_chinese: 萨利什人和彭德奥雷耶人的故土包括弗拉特黑德河与克拉克福克河谷，并越过群山向东延伸。人们往来于渔场、植物采集地和猎场之间，也前往分水岭另一侧的野牛平原。1809年，戴维·汤普森在克拉克福克河畔为西北公司建立萨利什商站。毛皮贸易由此进入一片早已有原住民道路与社会关系相连的土地；汤普森在商站过冬后又返回北方。

english: Saleh Bay cuts deep into the northern coast of Sumbawa, almost dividing the island in two. Moyo Island and the Sanggar Peninsula partly enclose its broad waters, while smaller islands and shoals lie along its shores. The bay reaches far inland from the Flores Sea, with coastal settlements looking out over its sheltered expanse and the mountains beyond.
simp_chinese: 萨利赫湾深深伸入松巴哇岛北岸，几乎将岛屿一分为二。莫约岛和桑加尔半岛部分环抱着宽阔的海湾，岸边还有小岛与浅滩。海湾从弗洛勒斯海向内陆延伸，沿岸居民点面向这片较为隐蔽的水域及远处山岭。

english: Salehabad, formerly known as Zorabad, lies in the eastern Khorasan country north of Torbat-e Jam. The old fortress of Zorabad stands near the settlement, a reminder of the fortified places that once guarded communities in this region. The countryside extends toward the Hari Rud and the routes between Jam and Sarakhs, linking upland villages to the river valley.
simp_chinese: 萨利哈巴德旧称佐拉巴德，位于呼罗珊东部、托尔巴特贾姆以北。聚落附近有佐拉巴德旧堡垒，令人想起过去保护当地社群的设防地点。周边土地延伸至哈里河及贾姆与萨拉赫斯之间的道路，把高地村庄与河谷联系起来。

english:
Salem lies in the inland Tamil country, surrounded by hills that include the Shevaroys to the north. The town grew in a region known for its agriculture and ironworking, while the Sugavaneswarar temple provided a focus for worship. Its position between the uplands of Mysore and the plains of the Kaveri placed it within reach of several competing powers.

After the age of the great Tamil dynasties, the area came under Vijayanagara and then the Nayaks of Madurai. Local chiefs, including the Gatti Mudaliars, held strongholds in the surrounding country. In the eighteenth century Salem came under Haidar Ali and Tipu Sultan of Mysore, whose wars against the British transformed the region. Following the settlement of 1792, Salem became part of the territory ceded to the East India Company.
simp_chinese:
塞勒姆位于泰米尔内陆，四周环山，北面是舍瓦罗伊山。这里的乡野以农业和铁器制作闻名，苏加瓦内斯瓦拉神庙则是当地重要的礼拜场所。城镇处于迈索尔高地与高韦里平原之间，因而受到多个相互竞争的政权影响。

泰米尔诸大王朝之后，这一带先后处于毗奢耶那伽罗和马杜赖纳亚克统治之下。加蒂穆达利等地方首领在周边建立据点。十八世纪，塞勒姆归迈索尔的海德尔·阿里和蒂普苏丹统治，两人与英国的战争改变了地区格局。1792年议和后，塞勒姆成为割让给东印度公司的领土之一。

english: Salémata lies in the hilly Bassari country on the northern fringes of the Futa Jallon highlands. Villages and hamlets sit among terraces and rice fields, while wooded slopes rise above the cultivated ground. The Bassari, Bedik and Fula communities developed distinct ways of life in this varied landscape. The hills offered places of refuge as populations moved through the region over the centuries, and local farming and ritual traditions became closely tied to the terrain.
simp_chinese: 萨莱马塔位于富塔贾隆高地北缘的巴萨里丘陵地区。村庄和聚落散布在梯田与稻田之间，林木覆盖的山坡高出耕地。巴萨里、贝迪克和富拉社群在多样的环境中发展出各自的生活方式。数百年间人群在这一地区迁徙，山丘提供庇护之所，地方农业与仪式传统也与地形紧密相连。

english: Salemi stands among the hills of western Sicily, on the site associated with ancient Halyciae. A castle was built during the Norman period, around which the medieval town developed. After a period under feudal lordship, Salemi received the more favourable status of a royal town in 1392. In 1441 representatives of Salemi and other western Sicilian towns joined local barons in a defensive agreement at its castle. In 1542 a locust infestation damaged crops and brought famine; local tradition connects appeals for relief with Saint Blaise. The town's churches, castle and surrounding fields reflect its long life as an inland centre within Sicily's changing political order.
simp_chinese: 萨莱米位于西西里西部丘陵，与古代哈利西亚城址相联系。诺曼时期建起城堡，中世纪城镇围绕它发展。经历封建领主管辖后，萨莱米于1392年取得较有利的王室直属城市地位。1441年，萨莱米和西西里西部其他城镇的代表与地方男爵在城堡结成防卫联盟。1542年蝗灾损害农作物并引发饥荒，当地传统将祈求救助与圣布莱斯联系起来。城堡、教堂和周围田地体现了这座内陆中心在西西里政治变迁中的长期生活。

english:
Nestled between the sea and the mountains of the Amalfi coast on its sheltered gulf, Salerno was chosen by the Norman conqueror Robert Guiscard as his capital after seizing it in 1076, serving as the first seat of Norman power in southern Italy before the royal court moved to Palermo. The city is most renowned for its #italic Schola Medica Salernitana#!, the oldest medical school in Europe, which flourished from the 9th century onward by drawing together the Greek, Arab, and Latin medical traditions that converged on this cosmopolitan southern shore. Physicians trained at Salerno spread across the continent, and the school's texts on anatomy, surgery, and herbal medicine shaped the practice of medicine throughout the medieval world.

With the court gone to Palermo, Salerno lived on as a princely title. In 1272 Charles I of Anjou made it a principality reserved for the heir to the Neapolitan throne, and from the 14th century most of the province fell to a great baronial house whose princes ruled it as if they owned it, filling their palace with artists and men of letters; the poet Bernardo Tasso, father of Torquato, served the last of them as secretary. That prince quarrelled with the Spanish viceroy over the Inquisition in the early 1550s and fled to France, his estates were confiscated, and the city that had lived off its princes began a long decline. Its medical school lingered on, by then teaching from books alone, until Joachim Murat closed it in 1811.
simp_chinese:
萨莱诺坐落于阿马尔菲海岸山海之间的避风海湾中，被诺曼征服者罗贝尔·吉斯卡尔在1076年夺取后选为他的首都——在宫廷迁往巴勒莫之前，它曾是诺曼人在意大利南部的第一个权力中心。这座城市最为著名的是其#italic 萨莱诺医学院#!，这是欧洲最古老的医学院，从9世纪起繁荣发展，汇集了在此地交汇的希腊、阿拉伯和拉丁医学传统。在萨莱诺受训的医生遍布欧洲，该学校关于解剖学、外科学和草药学的著作塑造了整个中世纪世界的医学实践。

宫廷迁往巴勒莫之后，萨莱诺作为亲王的封号延续下来。1272年，安茹的查理一世把它立为专属那不勒斯王位继承人的亲王领；从14世纪起，这一省的大部分土地落入一个显赫的贵族世家之手，历代亲王俨然以主人自居，宫中聚集着艺术家和文人，诗人托尔夸托·塔索的父亲贝尔纳多·塔索就曾给末代亲王当秘书。16世纪50年代初，这位亲王因宗教裁判所一事与西班牙总督失和，逃往法国，领地被没收，靠亲王宫廷过活的萨莱诺从此长期衰落。医学院则苟延下来，只剩书本上的讲授，直到1811年被若阿尚·缪拉下令关闭。

english: The Saleta were among the indigenous groups associated with the western slopes of the Sierra de Comechingones, near the valley of Concarán. These mountains form part of the Sierras Pampeanas, where communities occupied valleys between wooded slopes and the drier plains to the west. The peoples known collectively as Comechingones inhabited the ranges of Córdoba and San Luis when Spanish conquerors entered the region in the sixteenth century.
simp_chinese: 萨莱塔人是与科梅钦戈内斯山脉西坡、孔卡兰河谷附近有关的原住民群体之一。这片山地属于潘帕山地，社群居住在林木覆盖的山坡与西部干旱平原之间的河谷中。十六世纪西班牙征服者进入这一地区时，统称为科梅钦戈内斯人的群体居住在科尔多瓦和圣路易斯的山岭间。

english: Salgótarján lies among the hills of northern Hungary, below the volcanic heights crowned by Salgó Castle. Built in the Middle Ages, the stronghold commanded the surrounding country from its steep summit. Its military importance became especially apparent during the wars between the Habsburgs and the Ottomans. Ottoman troops seized the castle in 1554, reportedly frightening its defenders with logs made to resemble cannon. Hungarian forces besieged Salgó in 1593, when the fortification burned; the ruined castle remained above the settlements in the valley.
simp_chinese: 萨尔戈陶尔扬坐落在匈牙利北部丘陵之间，萨尔戈城堡矗立在附近的火山高地上。这座中世纪要塞居高临下，控制着周围地区。哈布斯堡与奥斯曼的战争使它的军事价值尤为突出。1554年，奥斯曼军队夺取城堡；相传他们将木头伪装成大炮，吓跑了守军。1593年，匈牙利军队围攻萨尔戈，城堡在战事中焚毁，废墟仍俯瞰着山谷中的聚落。

english: Salianah, or Salyan, was a hill principality on the edge of the Dang country in western Nepal. It was one of the Baise Rajya, the small kingdoms of the Karnali and Bheri region, and was ruled by the Samala Shahi family before the expansion of the Gorkha state. Sri Krishna Shah abdicated in 1793; his successor Ranabhim Shah ruled until Salyan was annexed in 1809. Temples dedicated to Shiva and the goddess Devi stand in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 萨利亚纳又称萨利安，是尼泊尔西部当谷边缘的一处山地小邦。它属于卡尔纳利河和佩里河地区的拜塞诸邦，廓尔喀国家扩张之前由萨马拉·沙希家族统治。1793年，什里·克里希纳沙阿退位；其继承者拉纳比姆沙阿统治至1809年萨利安被吞并。周围地区有供奉湿婆和女神提毗的神庙。

english: The Salikuit Islands lie in eastern Hudson Bay, between the Belcher Islands and the mainland coast of Nunavik.
