Before permanent settlement, ships visiting the islands collected tortoises and other provisions for long voyages.
simp_chinese: 圣克鲁斯是一座位于加拉帕戈斯群岛中央附近的火山岛。干燥的海岸向高地升起，陆龟和海鬣蜥是这些偏远太平洋岛屿独特动物群的一部分。1832年，厄瓜多尔取得群岛，此后定居者来到圣克鲁斯寻找土地。在永久聚落出现之前，到访的船只会在群岛捕取陆龟和其他补给，以备漫长航行。

english:
The Santa Cruz River reaches the South Atlantic from the Patagonian interior, forming a conspicuous mouth along an exposed coast. Strong tides, winds, shoals and changing currents made entry and anchorage matters requiring care. Indigenous communities in the wider Patagonian country maintained routes and seasonal knowledge connecting inland resources with the shore.

European navigators encountered this coast while exploring the southern Atlantic and routes around South America. It became part of the geographical knowledge of voyages between the Atlantic and Pacific, although permanent colonial occupation remained limited for much of the early modern period. A river mouth could offer fresh water and shelter to ships, alongside hazards to navigation.
simp_chinese:
圣克鲁斯河从巴塔哥尼亚内陆注入南大西洋，在暴露的海岸上形成醒目的河口。强潮、风、浅滩和变化的水流使船只进出及停泊都需要谨慎。巴塔哥尼亚更广大地区的原住民社群，维持着连接内陆资源与海岸的路线及季节知识。

欧洲航海者在探索南大西洋和绕过南美洲的航路时来到这一海岸。这段海岸逐渐被纳入连接大西洋与太平洋的航行地理知识，但近代早期大部分时间里，永久殖民占领仍然有限。河口可能为船只提供淡水和庇护，同时也存在航行危险。

english: Santa Eufemia lies beneath the castle of Miramontes in the northern hills of Córdoba. The town became the centre of a lordship founded at the end of the thirteenth century, encompassing several neighbouring settlements. In 1478 the Catholic Monarchs ordered the castle destroyed to punish abuses by its lord and bring him to obedience, leaving the fortress a reminder of conflict between local power and the crown.
simp_chinese: 圣欧费米娅位于科尔多瓦北部丘陵中，米拉蒙特斯城堡俯瞰城镇。13世纪末，这里成为一片领地的中心，领地包括周围数个聚落。1478年，天主教双王为惩罚当地领主的暴行、迫使其服从，下令毁掉城堡。要塞遗迹令人想起地方权力与王室之间的冲突。

english: The Santa Inés mountains rise in the Central Cordillera of northern Antioquia. Their high ground includes the Belmira–Santa Inés páramo, a cool upland landscape above the surrounding Andean forests. Streams descend from the heights towards valleys on either side of the range. The páramo vegetation and mountain waters distinguish these heights from the lower, warmer country of the Cauca and Nechí basins.
simp_chinese: 圣伊内斯山地耸立在安蒂奥基亚北部的中央科迪勒拉山脉中。高处包括贝尔米拉—圣伊内斯帕拉莫，这片凉冷高地位于周围安第斯森林之上。溪流从山岭向两侧谷地流去。高寒草原植被与山地水源，使这里不同于考卡河和内奇河流域较低、较温暖的地区。

english: Santa Luzia grew beside the Rio das Velhas in the mining country of Minas Gerais. The first nucleus of the settlement was founded by bandeirantes in 1692, during the search for riches in the Brazilian interior. Its older streets and religious buildings recall the community that arose in the following centuries, when the river valley became part of the Portuguese colonial mining region.
simp_chinese: 圣卢西亚兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯矿区的韦利亚斯河畔。1692年，深入巴西内陆寻找财富的班德兰特人在此建立了聚落的最初核心。随着河谷成为葡萄牙殖民地采矿地区的一部分，社区逐渐发展，其老街和宗教建筑保存了这段历史的痕迹。

english: Santa Maria is the southeastern island of the Azores, with a hilly interior above its Atlantic shores. It was the first island of the archipelago to receive a Portuguese settlement, around 1440, under Gonçalo Velho Cabral. Vila do Porto became the first town in the islands. On his return from his first voyage to America in 1493, Christopher Columbus stopped at Santa Maria, where members of his crew went ashore at Anjos.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽亚是亚速尔群岛东南部的岛屿，起伏的内陆高地俯临大西洋海岸。约1440年，贡萨洛·韦略·卡布拉尔率领移民在此建立了群岛首个葡萄牙人聚落，港口镇后来成为群岛最早的市镇。1493年，克里斯托弗·哥伦布从首次美洲航行返程时在圣玛丽亚停泊，他的部分船员在安若什上岸。

english: The bay of Santa Marta lies on Colombia’s northern Caribbean shore beneath the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. The mountains rise close to the sea, giving this coast a striking profile. The Spanish founded Santa Marta in 1525 beside the bay, establishing an early colonial foothold on the South American mainland. Its harbour joined the city to other Caribbean ports and to the maritime routes along the northern coast.
simp_chinese: 圣玛尔塔湾位于哥伦比亚北部加勒比海岸，背靠圣玛尔塔内华达山脉。群山靠近海边拔地而起，使海岸轮廓格外鲜明。西班牙人于1525年在湾旁建立圣玛尔塔，成为南美大陆上的早期殖民据点。港口将城市与其他加勒比港口及北岸航路连接起来。

english: Cape Santa María stands on the Atlantic coast of Uruguay, east of the broad mouth of the Río de la Plata. Its rocky projection and neighbouring bays mark the approach to the estuary for ships sailing along this shore. In the sixteenth century the cape was treated as a gateway to the great river explored by Juan Díaz de Solís.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽亚角位于乌拉圭大西洋海岸，在拉普拉塔河宽阔河口以东。岩石岬角和附近海湾为沿岸航行的船只标示通向河口的路径。十六世纪，海角被视为进入胡安·迪亚斯·德索利斯探索的大河的门户。

english: The waters around Santa Maria surround the southeastern island of the Azores. Portuguese settlers established themselves on the island around 1440 under Gonçalo Velho Cabral, making it the first settled island of the archipelago. In 1493 Christopher Columbus reached Santa Maria on his return from his first voyage to America. Members of his crew went ashore at Anjos, where they sought to give thanks after their dangerous crossing.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽亚岛周围的海水环绕着亚速尔群岛东南端的岛屿。约1440年，葡萄牙移民在贡萨洛·韦略·卡布拉尔率领下在岛上定居，圣玛丽亚由此成为群岛最早有人定居的岛屿。1493年，克里斯托弗·哥伦布结束首次美洲航行返程时抵达这里。部分船员在安若什上岸，为渡海脱险而举行感恩仪式。

english: The sea north of Marajó Island lies at the edge of the vast Amazon estuary. Fresh water and suspended sediment spread outward from the river mouth, while tides sweep across low islands and shallow banks. The northern shore of Marajó faces the southern Amazon channel, and its creeks open onto waters where the river’s seasonal flood and the Atlantic continually meet.
simp_chinese: 马拉若岛以北的海域位于广阔亚马孙河口的边缘。淡水和悬浮泥沙从河口向外扩散，潮汐则掠过低矮岛屿和浅滩。马拉若岛北岸面向亚马孙河南汊，沿岸溪道通向河流季节性洪水与大西洋不断交汇的水域。

english: Santal Bay cuts into the western coast of Lifou, the largest of the Loyalty Islands. Between its headlands the seabed slopes steeply down from a narrow coral-fringed margin. Lifou is the home of Drehu speakers, whose language belongs to the Loyalty Islands group. In 1793 the merchant ship Britannia, under William Raven, mapped Lifou and other islands of the group during a voyage towards Batavia.
simp_chinese: 桑塔尔湾深入洛亚蒂群岛最大岛屿利富的西岸。两侧岬角之间，海床从珊瑚环绕的狭窄边缘陡然下降。利富是德雷胡语使用者的家园，这种语言属于洛亚蒂群岛语支。1793年，威廉·雷文率商船“布里塔尼亚”号驶往巴达维亚途中，测绘了利富及群岛中的其他岛屿。

english: Santana Island lies in the Amazon estuary opposite the northern bank, near the deep channel leading upriver. Its position made the waters around it a point of interest to European powers seeking control of the river mouth. An English fort stood opposite the island in the early seventeenth century, and a settlement developed on the island in the eighteenth century. Wide tidal waters surround its forested banks.
simp_chinese: 圣安娜岛位于亚马孙河口，面对北岸，靠近通向上游的深水道。岛屿的位置使其周围水域受到争夺河口控制权的欧洲势力关注。十七世纪初，英国人在岛对岸设有堡垒；十八世纪，岛上发展出一处聚落。宽阔的潮汐水域环绕着森林覆盖的岛岸。

english:
Santander lies on a sheltered bay of the Cantabrian coast. After the Castilian fleet's victory over the English at La Rochelle in 1372, Henry II entered the port, which became the Atlantic naval base of the crown, with royal shipyards like those of Seville and Barcelona. In 1466 Henry IV gave the town to the Marquis of Santillana. Plague in 1596–97 left only 800 of its 2,500 people.

In 1748 the crown ordered a road built through Reinosa to carry Castile's wool and flour to the port. In 1754 Santander became a diocese and the abbey of the Holy Bodies a cathedral, and in 1755 Ferdinand VI granted it the title of city. Free trade with Spanish America from 1765 opened its commerce to the Atlantic, and by the early nineteenth century Santander led the exchanges between the north of the peninsula and the major American ports.
simp_chinese:
桑坦德位于坎塔布里亚海岸一处有遮蔽的海湾。1372年卡斯蒂利亚舰队在拉罗谢尔战胜英军后，恩里克二世进入该港，这里成为王国的大西洋海军基地，设有类似塞维利亚和巴塞罗那的王家船厂。1466年，恩里克四世把该城赐给桑蒂利亚纳侯爵。1596至1597年的鼠疫使两千五百居民只剩八百人。

1748年，王室下令修筑经雷诺萨的道路，把卡斯蒂利亚的羊毛和面粉运往港口。1754年桑坦德设立教区，圣体修道院的教堂成为主教座堂，1755年费尔南多六世授予它城市称号。1765年起与西属美洲自由贸易，使它的商业向大西洋敞开，到19世纪初，桑坦德在半岛北部与美洲各主要港口的往来中居领先地位。

english: Sant'Angelo dei Lombardi stands on a hill in the inland country of Irpinia. The Normans fortified its castle in 1076. Nearby, William of Vercelli founded the abbey of Goleto in 1133–34 on land given by Roger of Monticchio. The religious community grew to include separate houses for women and men, with churches built amid the remains of an older Roman site.
simp_chinese: 圣安杰洛代伦巴第坐落在伊尔皮尼亚内陆的一座山丘上。诺曼人于1076年加强了当地城堡。附近的戈莱托修道院由韦尔切利的古列尔莫于1133至1134年在蒙蒂基奥的罗杰捐赠的土地上创建。修院后来设有男女分住的院舍，教堂建在一处更古老的罗马遗址之间。

english: Sant'Arcangelo stands above the Agri valley in Basilicata, among hills of olives and vines. Nearby, on the hill of Orsoleo, a Franciscan convent overlooks the routes between the Agri and Sinni valleys. The complex was rebuilt in 1474 around an older church and entrusted to the Observant Franciscans. Its church and cloister became a place of prayer and study for the surrounding region, joining the hill town to a wider network of religious houses.
simp_chinese: 圣阿尔坎杰洛坐落在巴西利卡塔的阿格里河谷上方，周围丘陵种植橄榄和葡萄。附近奥尔索莱奥山上的方济各会修道院俯瞰阿格里与辛尼河谷之间的道路。建筑群于1474年围绕一座旧教堂重建，并交给严规方济各会士。教堂和回廊成为周边地区祈祷与学习之所，将山城连接到更广泛的宗教机构网络。

english:
Santarém stands on a bluff above the Tagus, the old capital of the Ribatejo. The Romans called it Scallabis, and under Muslim rule, as Shantarin, it became a cultural centre. On 15 March 1147 Afonso Henriques took it by a night attack, when a few men climbed the walls and opened the gates, a chronicle of the conquest tells the exploit. For a time Santarém, the town of Saint Irene, the martyr who gave it its name, was one of the most important in Portugal.

Medieval kings came often to its royal palace, and many sessions of the Cortes, the Portuguese assembly, were held here. Ferdinand I loved the town and chose to be buried in the Convent of São Francisco. The expedition against Ceuta in 1415 was planned in the palace of Santarém. Pedro de Meneses, Ceuta's first governor, lies in a Gothic tomb in the Church of Graça, and in the same church rests Pedro Álvares Cabral, who reached Brazil in 1500. As the court drifted toward coastal Lisbon, Santarém lost its importance, and earthquakes damaged it in 1531 and 1755.
simp_chinese:
圣塔伦坐落在特茹河上方的一处高崖上，是里巴特茹的旧首府。罗马人称它斯卡拉比斯，穆斯林统治时期它叫尚塔林，是一处文化中心。1147年3月15日，阿方索·恩里克斯夜袭夺城，几个人爬上城墙，打开城门，一部征服编年史讲述了这次壮举。这座以殉道者圣伊里亚得名的城市，曾是葡萄牙最重要的城镇之一。

中世纪的国王常到它的王宫，许多次葡萄牙议会在这里召开。费尔南多一世钟爱此城，选择葬在圣方济各修道院。1415年远征休达的计划就是在圣塔伦的王宫里制订的。休达首任总督佩德罗·德·梅内塞斯安葬在恩典教堂的哥特式墓中，1500年抵达巴西的佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔也安息在这座教堂里。随着宫廷转向滨海的里斯本，圣塔伦逐渐失势，1531年和1755年的地震又先后破坏了城市。

english:
The Santee country lies along the rivers and lowlands of coastal South Carolina. Indigenous communities used its waters for travel and fishing, while nearby fields and forests supplied crops, game and materials. The Santee people belonged to the varied native societies encountered by European colonists in the Carolina region. Their lives were disrupted by disease, warfare and the destructive trade in enslaved indigenous people during the colonial expansion.

In 1701 the English traveller John Lawson encountered Santee and Wateree people along the river. In 1715 the Santee joined other Indigenous peoples in the Yamasee War against Carolina's colonists and traders; after the conflict, Santee and Wateree people withdrew toward Catawba settlements. Meanwhile, English settlement and rice plantations increasingly reshaped the lowcountry, relying on the forced labour and knowledge of enslaved Africans.
simp_chinese:
桑蒂地区沿南卡罗来纳沿海河流与低地展开。原住民社群利用水道交通和捕鱼，附近田地与森林提供作物、猎物及材料。桑蒂人属于欧洲殖民者在卡罗来纳接触的多样本土社会。随着殖民扩张，他们的生活遭到疾病、战争及贩卖原住民为奴的破坏性贸易冲击，人口和土地关系发生深刻变化。

1701年，英格兰旅行者约翰·劳森沿河遇见桑蒂人和沃特里人。1715年，桑蒂人同其他原住民族群一起，在亚马西战争中反抗卡罗来纳殖民者和商人；冲突后，桑蒂人与沃特里人退向卡托巴人的聚落。与此同时，英格兰殖民与稻米种植园日益改变沿海低地，种植园依赖被奴役非洲人的强迫劳动和知识。

english: Santeh lies in the mountain country east of Saqqez, among the ridges of Iranian Kurdistan. Villages occupy sheltered valleys between pastures, and stone houses rise along the slopes. The surrounding country has long been home to Kurdish communities whose flocks grazed the uplands. Streams from these mountains flow northward toward the basin of Lake Urmia.
simp_chinese: 桑特位于萨盖兹以东的山区，坐落在伊朗库尔德斯坦的山脊之间。村庄占据牧场之间较为隐蔽的谷地，石屋沿山坡而建。周围土地长期为库尔德社群的家园，羊群在高地放牧；山间溪流向北流往乌尔米耶湖盆地。

english:
Santiago is the largest of the Cape Verde islands and the first to be settled by the Portuguese. Mountains and valleys rise behind its southern shore, where Ribeira Grande became a meeting place of Atlantic routes. The island's society grew from encounters between Europeans and Africans, many of the latter brought there in bondage, and gave rise to a distinctive Creole culture.

In 1462 António de Noli and settlers from Portugal established Ribeira Grande. Its position helped make the town a port of call for ships traveling between Africa, Europe and the Americas. From the sixteenth century it also became a center of the trade in enslaved Africans. Churches and the carved pillory in the town square testified to the institutions of colonial rule, while the royal fort of São Filipe was built above the town after Francis Drake's raid in 1585.

The wealth of Ribeira Grande drew further attackers. In 1712 the French privateer Jacques Cassard struck the town, which subsequently declined as Praia grew in importance. The colonial capital moved to Praia in 1770, but the older port remained a mark of the island's place in Atlantic navigation and the history of enslavement. Ships calling at Santiago carried people and goods between the West African coast, Brazil and the Caribbean, connecting the island to distant shores.

The later city of Praia lies here.
simp_chinese:
圣地亚哥是佛得角群岛最大的岛屿，也是葡萄牙人最早定居的岛。南岸背后山谷起伏，海边的大里贝拉成为大西洋航线的交汇之地。岛上社会在欧洲人与非洲人的相遇中形成，许多非洲人是被奴役带来的；这种相遇孕育出独特的克里奥尔文化。

1462年，安东尼奥·德诺利与来自葡萄牙的移民建立大里贝拉。凭借地理位置，城镇成为往来非洲、欧洲与美洲的船只停靠之地。十六世纪起，它也成为贩运被奴役非洲人的中心。教堂和广场上雕刻精美的示众柱体现了殖民统治的制度；1585年弗朗西斯·德雷克袭击之后，圣菲利普皇家堡垒建在城镇上方。

大里贝拉的财富引来更多袭击。1712年，法国私掠船长雅克·卡萨尔攻打城镇，此后大里贝拉逐渐衰落，普拉亚则日益重要。1770年，殖民地首府迁往普拉亚，而旧港仍保存着这座岛屿参与大西洋航行与奴役历史的印记。停靠圣地亚哥的船只在西非海岸、巴西与加勒比之间运送人口和货物，使岛屿与遥远海岸相连。

后来的普拉亚即位于此地。

english:
In the early 9th century the hermit Pelayo, guided by a strange star above an oak grove in the wild hills of Galicia, was led to a Roman tomb. Bishop Theodemir of Iria Flavia identified it as the burial place of the apostle James, the brother of John, whose body was carried there by his disciples after his martyrdom in Jerusalem. King Alfonso II of Asturias raised the first church over the rediscovered tomb, and through the 11th and 12th centuries Santiago de Compostela grew into the third greatest pilgrimage destination of Christendom after Rome and Jerusalem, the apostle's #italic concha#! shells worn on the hats of penitents from every corner of Europe. The great Romanesque cathedral begun in 1075 by Bishop Diego Peláez and continued by the formidable Bishop Diego Gelmírez dominated the end of the #italic Camino Francés#!, the most traveled road in medieval Europe, and the archbishopric of Compostela ranked among the most powerful and contested ecclesiastical lordships of Latin Christendom.

It was contested above all by its own townspeople. In 1318, led by the noble Afonso Suárez de Deza, they rose against a new French archbishop, Berenguel de Landoria, and fought him for two years, until on 16 September 1320 the rebel leaders were killed at his castle of Rocha Forte, a day remembered as the Day of Wrath. The crown took a firmer hand under the Catholic Monarchs, who visited in 1486 and ordered a great hospital for the pilgrims beside the cathedral, built between 1501 and 1511. Its next great change came from its own masons. From about 1670 Galician architects such as Domingo de Andrade, who raised the cathedral's clock tower, rebuilt church after church in the Baroque style, giving the pilgrims' goal a new face of carved granite.
simp_chinese:
相传在9世纪初，隐士佩拉约在加利西亚荒山野岭的一片橡树林上空，发现了一颗异星。在星光的指引下，他找到了一座罗马时期的墓葬。伊里亚·弗拉维亚的主教特奥德米尔确认，这就是约翰的兄弟使徒雅各的安息之地。据说，雅各在耶路撒冷殉道后，他的门徒将他的遗体带到了这里。阿斯图里亚斯国王阿方索二世在重新发现的墓穴上修建了第一座教堂。到了11和12世纪，圣地亚哥‑德孔波斯特拉逐渐发展成为继罗马和耶路撒冷之后，基督教世界的第三大朝圣圣地。来自欧洲各个角落的忏悔者将雅各的#italic 扇贝#!徽章佩戴在帽子上。宏伟的罗马式大教堂始建于1075年，由迭戈·佩拉埃斯主教发起，并由继任者迭戈·赫尔米雷斯主教持续推进。这座教堂坐落在中世纪欧洲最繁忙的道路#italic 法兰西之路#!的终点。孔波斯特拉大主教区是拉丁基督教世界中最有权势、也最受争议的教会领地之一。

争夺这块领地的，首先是城里自己的市民。1318年，市民在贵族阿方索·苏亚雷斯·德·德萨带领下起兵，反对新上任的法国籍大主教贝伦格尔·德·兰多里亚，与他对抗了两年；直到1320年9月16日，起义首领在大主教的城堡里被杀，这一天后来被称为“愤怒之日”。到天主教双王时，王权伸得更深：两位君主1486年到访后，下令在主教座堂旁修建一座大型朝圣者医院，1501年至1511年建成。此后让城市改头换面的，是本地的工匠。约从1670年起，修建主教座堂钟楼的多明戈·德·安德拉德等加利西亚建筑师，用巴洛克风格把一座座教堂逐一重建，给这座朝圣终点换上了一副雕花的花岗岩新面孔。

english: Santiago is a volcanic island in the Galápagos, with a rugged coast and a scarce supply of fresh water. A small seep near Buccaneer Cove was recorded by sailors including William Dampier and Ambrose Cowley in 1684, and later by the privateer Woodes Rogers. Visiting ships also took giant tortoises as provisions. In 1835 Charles Darwin visited the island and noted the spring used by tortoise hunters to obtain their daily water.
simp_chinese: 圣地亚哥是加拉帕戈斯群岛的一座火山岛，海岸崎岖，淡水稀少。1684年，威廉·丹皮尔和安布罗斯·考利等水手记下了海盗湾附近的一处小泉眼；后来私掠船长伍兹·罗杰斯也提到它。来访船只还捕取巨型陆龟作为补给。1835年，查尔斯·达尔文到访此岛，记下了猎龟人获取日常饮水的泉水。

english: Santianna Point forms the low western end of Coats Island in northern Hudson Bay. Inland from the shore lies a plain dotted with ponds and raised beaches, while shallow water extends out from the point. Across the entrance to Fisher Strait stands Cape Low on Southampton Island. Walrus use the ice and islands between the two shores, and Inuit travel to Coats Island to hunt caribou. The strait opens southwest towards the wider bay.
simp_chinese: 圣蒂安娜角是哈得孙湾北部科茨岛低平的西端。岸后平原上散布着池塘和抬升的海滩，岬角外则是延伸向海的浅水。隔着菲舍尔海峡入口，南安普顿岛上的洛角与之相望。海象活动于两岸之间的海冰与岛屿，因纽特人也前往科茨岛猎取北美驯鹿。海峡向西南通往开阔的海湾。

english: Cape Santiago, known as Sandiaojiao, marks the easternmost point of Taiwan. Here the northern end of the Xueshan range reaches the sea, forming a rocky headland on the island’s northeastern coast. The cape belongs to a shore of alternating bays and promontories, shaped as the sea and weather wore away rocks of differing hardness.
simp_chinese: 三貂角是台湾岛最东端的岬角。雪山山脉北端在此伸入海中，在岛屿东北岸形成岩石岬角。这一带海岸湾岬相间，海水和风化侵蚀不同硬度的岩层，塑造出曲折的岸线。

english: Santo Antão is the northwesternmost island of Cape Verde, a mountainous land separated from São Vicente by a narrow channel. Deep valleys cut through its volcanic slopes, and the town of Ribeira Grande grew in one of them. Diogo Afonso reached the island in 1461 or 1462, and settlement began in the first half of the sixteenth century. Ribeira Grande became the principal settlement and, in 1732, the seat of the island's municipality.
simp_chinese: 圣安唐是佛得角群岛最西北的岛屿，山峦耸立，一条狭窄海峡将它与圣维森特岛隔开。深谷切入火山山坡，里贝拉格兰德城便在其中一条谷地发展起来。迪奥戈·阿丰索于1461或1462年抵达此岛，十六世纪上半叶开始有人定居。里贝拉格兰德成为主要聚落，并在1732年成为全岛的行政中心。

english: The Santo Antônio River runs through the wooded uplands of southwestern Paraná toward the Iguaçu. Together with the Chopim and other streams, it drains a country of forested hills and open fields. These lands formed part of the extensive territory of the Kaingang before colonial expeditions and settlers pushed into the southern Brazilian plateau.
simp_chinese: 圣安东尼奥河流经巴拉那西南部森林覆盖的高地，流向伊瓜苏河。它与绍平河等水道共同为林木覆盖的丘陵与开阔原野排水。在殖民远征队和定居者进入巴西南部高原之前，这些土地是凯因甘人广大领地的一部分。

english: Santo Antônio do Monte grew around a chapel on a hill in western Minas Gerais. In 1758 Lopo Barroso Pereira received a land grant beside the Itaubira stream, close to the chapel and land he had already occupied. Families settled on farms in the surrounding country, and the chapel became the centre of their community. It received a baptismal font in 1802.
simp_chinese: 圣安东尼奥杜蒙特围绕米纳斯吉拉斯西部山丘上的一座小教堂发展。1758年，洛普·巴罗苏·佩雷拉在伊陶比拉溪旁获得土地，靠近教堂和他此前已占据的土地。众多家庭在周围农场定居，小教堂成为社区中心，并于1802年获准设置洗礼池。

english:
Santok stands where the Noteć joins the Warta, a crossing long guarded by a fortified settlement. The chronicler Gallus Anonymus called it a key to the Polish realm on the Pomeranian frontier. In the thirteenth century the fortress became a focus of rivalry between Greater Poland and the margraves of Brandenburg; after several changes of hands it passed to Brandenburg in 1296.

King Casimir III recovered Santok temporarily in 1365, but its old fortress later lost much of its importance to nearby Landsberg. In 1402 the Neumark was sold to the Teutonic Order, and Hussite troops devastated Santok in 1433. A great flood changed the course of the Warta in 1751, leaving the old stronghold separated from the river's new channel; Russian troops plundered the settlement in 1758.
simp_chinese:
桑托克位于诺泰奇河汇入瓦尔塔河之处，一座设防聚落长期守卫着这一交汇点。编年史家加卢斯·阿诺尼穆斯称它为波兰王国在波美拉尼亚边境的钥匙。十三世纪，这座堡垒成为大波兰与勃兰登堡藩侯争夺的焦点；几经易手后，它于1296年归属勃兰登堡。

1365年，卡齐米日三世国王暂时收复桑托克，但堡垒后来被附近兰茨贝格的兴起所取代。1402年，诺伊马克被售予条顿骑士团；1433年，胡斯派军队破坏了桑托克。1751年的大洪水改变瓦尔塔河道，使旧堡垒与新河道分离；1758年俄罗斯军队又劫掠了聚落。

english: Santokhe, known in Chinese as Santanghu, lies in the dry basin north of Barkol. Its name recalls three patches of water and grass among the hills. The oasis offered a stopping place on routes across the Gobi, where camel caravans could rest before continuing towards Mongolia. Across the wider Barkol country, old beacon towers mark the network of communication routes through the frontier.
simp_chinese: 三都克即三塘湖，位于巴里坤以北干旱盆地。地名使人想起丘陵间三处水草地。绿洲为穿越戈壁的道路提供歇脚处，骆驼商队在此休整后继续向蒙古前行。巴里坤广大地区仍有古代烽燧，标示着穿越边地的通信网络。

english:
Beneath Mount Santubong, near the mouth of the Sarawak River, lay one of western Borneo's important early trading centers. The river gave access to a forested hinterland rich in camphor, resin and rattan, while ships arriving from the South China Sea brought goods from farther afield. Chinese ceramics, glass beads and religious images found in the area testify to these connections.

Santubong also had a substantial iron-working industry. Slag found at sites such as Sungai Jaong and Bongkisam lies alongside imported ceramics, many dating from the Song and early Yuan periods. The settlement's most active centuries appear to have been the twelfth and thirteenth, before the close of the medieval era. Its remains reveal a coast where local production and overseas exchange met long before later colonial ports emerged.

The later city of Kuching lies here.
simp_chinese:
桑都望山脚下、砂拉越河口附近，曾有婆罗洲西部重要的早期贸易中心。河流通向盛产樟脑、树脂和藤条的森林腹地，来自南中国海的船只则带来更远地区的货物。当地发现的中国陶瓷、玻璃珠和宗教造像见证了这些联系。

桑都望还有规模可观的铁器生产。双溪饶昂和邦基萨姆等遗址的炉渣与进口陶瓷一同出土，许多陶瓷可追溯至宋和元初时期。聚落最活跃的时期似乎是十二至十三世纪，早于中世纪结束。这些遗存展现了地方生产与海外交换交汇的海岸，远早于后来殖民港口的兴起。

后来的古晋即位于此地。

english: Sanyao lies in the mountainous Shangzhou region of southeastern Shaanxi, where valleys and passes connect different parts of central China and level ground is scarce. Cultivation clings to narrow valley floors and terraces, while the uplands supply timber and grazing. Roads through the passes carried traffic between the Guanzhong plain and the Han basin, and settlements along them depended on this movement.
simp_chinese: 三要位于陕西东南的商州山地，河谷与山口连接中国中部不同地区，平坦土地稀少。耕作集中在狭窄的河谷与梯田上，高地则提供木材和牧场。穿越山口的道路把关中平原与汉水流域连接起来，沿途聚落依赖这种往来。

english: In the dry country near Habaswein, the waters of the Ewaso Ng'iro spread into the Lorian Swamp. The river rises on Mount Kenya and the Aberdares, but its floodwaters reach far into the northeastern lowlands. Grasses and sedges grow in different parts of the wetland according to the depth and duration of flooding. Farther southeast, Sanye is a name shared by several hunting peoples, including the Dahalo of the lower Tana.
simp_chinese: 哈巴斯韦因附近地势干旱，埃瓦索恩吉罗河的水却在这里漫成洛里安沼泽。河流发源于肯尼亚山和阿伯代尔山脉，洪水远达东北低地。湿地各处的积水深浅和持续时间不同，因而生长着不同的草与莎草。更东南方的塔纳河下游，达哈洛人等狩猎社群也被称作桑耶。

english: Sanyuan lies in central Shaanxi, north of the Wei River plain and near the lower Jing River. The county was established under Northern Wei in 446; an early geographical work explains its name by reference to three nearby tablelands. During the Ming and Qing periods, merchants from Sanyuan became prominent among Shaanxi's trading networks. They carried grain, cloth and tea toward the northwestern frontier and obtained salt permits, then traded in salt from the Huai region and Sichuan. Their activities connected a farming county on the Guanzhong plain with markets and supply routes far beyond it.
simp_chinese: 三原位于陕西中部、渭河平原北缘和泾河下游附近。北魏太平真君七年（446年）置县；《元和郡县志》以附近三处原地解释其名称。明清时期，三原商人是陕西商帮的重要力量，他们把粮食、布匹和茶叶运往西北边地，换取盐引，再到两淮和四川经营盐业。商人的路线将关中平原的农业县城与远方市场和边地供应联系起来。

english: Sanyyakhtakh stands on the left bank of the Lena and takes its name from a local stream. The great river passes through wooded country here on its way toward central Yakutia. In the eighteenth century a postal station was established at Sanyyakhtakh on the route linking Vitim and Yakutsk. Horses and drivers relayed travellers and messages between stations along the river, spanning the vast distances of the Siberian interior.
simp_chinese: 桑尼亚赫塔赫位于勒拿河左岸，以当地溪流得名。大河在此流经林地，继续向雅库特中部流去。十八世纪，维季姆至雅库茨克驿路在桑尼亚赫塔赫设站。沿河各站的马匹和驿夫接力运送旅客与消息，跨越西伯利亚内陆的漫长距离。

english:
Sanzana lies in the wooded savanna of southern Mali, in the country of farming villages between the upper Niger basin and the Mouhoun. The wider region has long been home to Senufo-speaking communities as well as Mande-speaking neighbours. Seasonal rains sustain fields of grain, while trees and pasture surround the settlements. Routes through this country link the villages of the southern savanna with the trading centres of the western Volta basin.

The later city of Sikasso lies here.
simp_chinese:
桑扎纳位于马里南部林地草原，处在尼日尔河上游流域与穆翁河之间的农业村落地区。广大地区长期是塞努福语社群及其曼德语邻居的家园。季节性降雨滋养谷物田地，树木和牧场环绕聚落。穿越这片土地的道路将南部草原村落与西伏尔塔河流域的贸易中心相连。

后来的锡卡索即位于此地。

english: The country later known as São Carlos lies on the inland plateau of São Paulo, among the headwaters of rivers flowing toward the Tietê. A trail toward the gold mines of Goiás and Cuiabá crossed the region in the late eighteenth century. Land grants followed, including the Pinhal estate, whose boundaries were formally measured in 1831. Cattle and sugar cultivation developed on these lands.
simp_chinese: 后来称为圣卡洛斯的地区位于圣保罗内陆高原，附近河流发源后流向提埃特河。十八世纪末，一条通往戈亚斯与库亚巴金矿的小路穿过这里。随后出现土地授予，其中皮尼亚尔庄园于1831年正式划定边界；养牛和甘蔗种植在这些土地上发展起来。

english: São Fidélis lies beside the Paraíba do Sul in the wooded interior of Rio de Janeiro. Coroado and Puri peoples inhabited this region before colonial settlements expanded along the river. In 1781 Capuchin friars Vitório de Cambiasca and Ângelo Maria de Luca arrived to establish a mission among Indigenous communities. The settlement that grew around their work became São Fidélis.
simp_chinese: 圣菲德利斯位于里约热内卢森林覆盖的内陆，坐落在南帕拉伊巴河畔。殖民聚落沿河扩展之前，科罗阿多人和普里人居住于此。1781年，嘉布遣会修士维托里奥·迪坎比亚斯卡和安杰洛·玛丽亚·迪卢卡抵达，在原住民社区中建立传教聚落。围绕他们活动形成的聚落后来成为圣菲德利斯。

english: The São Francisco reaches the Atlantic between Alagoas and Sergipe, after a long course through the Brazilian interior. Its estuary meets a coastal plain of dunes, wetlands, mangroves and sandy ridges. The river carries fresh water and sediment toward the sea, where shoals mark the meeting of river and ocean. Known to the Portuguese as the São Francisco from the early sixteenth century, it became a route into the interior of northeastern Brazil.
simp_chinese: 圣弗朗西斯科河穿过巴西内陆，最终在阿拉戈斯与塞尔希培之间注入大西洋。河口濒临由沙丘、湿地、红树林和沙脊组成的海岸平原。河水将淡水与泥沙带向大海，在河海交会处形成浅滩。葡萄牙人自十六世纪初称其为圣弗朗西斯科河，后来沿河进入巴西东北部内陆。

english:
São João del-Rei grew in the basin of the Rio das Mortes, among the mountains of Minas Gerais. Gold-bearing gravels attracted settlers from São Paulo, and a mining camp developed into a town whose churches and streets reflect the wealth and ambitions of the colonial gold districts. Its place on the roads through southern Minas made it a centre of trade as well as mining.

The early settlement stood amid the conflicts of the War of the Emboabas, when rivals fought over the new goldfields. In 1713 it became a town named for King João V and subsequently expanded as a centre of the Rio das Mortes district. Churches and religious brotherhoods played a prominent part in its public life. The town was also drawn into the disturbances of 1720, when opposition to royal taxes and foundries spread across the mining region. Its commercial connections helped sustain it as the great gold rush passed.
simp_chinese:
圣若昂德尔雷兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯群山中的莫尔蒂斯河流域。含金砂砾吸引圣保罗移民前来，采矿营地逐渐发展为城镇；教堂与街道反映出殖民金矿地区的财富和雄心。它位于穿过米纳斯南部的道路上，也是商业与采矿中心。

早期聚落经历了恩博阿巴斯战争，争夺新金矿的对手在这一带交战。1713年，它以国王若昂五世之名升格为镇，随后发展为莫尔蒂斯河辖区的中心。教堂与宗教兄弟会在公共生活中占有重要地位。1720年，反对王室税收和熔金所的动乱席卷矿区，镇上也受到影响。淘金热过去后，商业联系帮助这座城镇维持活力。

english: The high country around São Joaquim forms part of the southern Brazilian plateau, where cool weather, grasslands and araucaria forest distinguish the landscape from the coastal lowlands. The Xokleng and Kaingang inhabited these uplands before colonial settlement expanded along cattle routes. Streams descend from the heights toward the rivers that cross the plateau and the valleys leading to the Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 圣若阿金周围的高地属于巴西南部高原，凉爽气候、草原和南洋杉森林使其景观有别于沿海低地。殖民定居沿牛群运输道路扩张之前，肖克伦人和凯因甘人居住在这些高地。溪流从山上流下，流向穿过高原的河流及通往大西洋的河谷。

english: Long and narrow, São Jorge lies in the central group of the Azores, separated by sea from its island neighbors. Its high coast is broken by small low-lying coastal plains known as fajãs. Settlements existed on the western and southern shores by about 1470, when the Fleming Willem van der Haegen established himself at Topo. Velas became a town before the end of the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 狭长的圣若热岛位于亚速尔群岛中部，与邻岛隔海相望。高峻的海岸间分布着称为法让的小片滨海平地。约1470年，岛的西岸和南岸已有聚落，佛兰德人威廉·范德哈亨在托普定居。十五世纪末以前，韦拉什获授市镇地位。

english: The wooded plateau south of Curitiba was known for its stands of araucaria, the pines that gave São José dos Pinhais its name. Gold in the rivers drew prospectors into the region during the seventeenth century, and a settlement called Arraial Grande emerged along the Arraial River. Around 1690 a chapel dedicated to Bom Jesus dos Perdões was established on a nearby estate.
simp_chinese: 库里提巴以南的森林高原以南洋杉林闻名，圣若泽杜斯皮尼亚伊斯的名称也与这些树木有关。十七世纪，河流中的黄金吸引探矿者进入该地区，阿拉亚尔河畔出现了阿拉亚尔格兰德聚落。约1690年，附近庄园建立了一座供奉宽恕耶稣的小教堂。

english: The Rio Preto flows through the wooded interior of São Paulo, a landscape of streams and rolling uplands west of the coast. Indigenous communities, including Kaingang and Guarani peoples, inhabited the wider region before the settlement that later took the name São José do Rio Preto. The river belongs to a network of waterways flowing toward the Paraná basin.
simp_chinese: 普雷图河流经圣保罗内陆的森林地区，海岸以西的溪流与起伏高地交错。后来称为圣若泽杜里奥普雷图的聚落出现之前，包括凯因甘人和瓜拉尼人在内的原住民社区已生活在更广阔的地区。河流属于流向巴拉那流域的水道网络。

english:
São Leopoldo stands in the valley of the Sinos River, north of the Guaíba waters in southern Brazil. A government hemp plantation, the Real Feitoria do Linho Cânhamo, operated there from 1788 before the site was chosen for a new colony. In 1824 the first group of German immigrants arrived and established São Leopoldo. The river connected their settlement with Porto Alegre and the wider lagoon system.

The later city of Porto Alegre lies here.
simp_chinese:
圣莱奥波尔多位于巴西南部锡诺斯河谷，瓜伊巴水域以北。1788年起，政府在此经营皇家大麻种植场，后来选定该地点建立新殖民地。1824年，首批德国移民抵达并建立圣莱奥波尔多。河流将他们的聚落与阿雷格里港及更广阔的潟湖水系相连。

后来的阿雷格里港即位于此地。

english: São Luís do Paraitinga stands beside the Paraitinga River among the forested hills of the Serra do Mar. Drovers travelling from Taubaté toward the port of Paraty stopped on the riverbank before a settlement was formally laid out in 1769. The place took its name from the river and the governor who ordered its foundation. Mining, sugar mills and dairy farming later supported the community.
simp_chinese: 圣路易斯杜帕赖廷加坐落在海岸山脉森林丘陵中的帕赖廷加河畔。1769年聚落正式规划之前，从陶巴特前往帕拉蒂港的赶牲口者已常在河边停留。地名取自河流和下令建立聚落的总督。此后，采矿、糖坊和乳业为社区提供生计。

english: São Marcos Bay is a broad estuary on the Maranhão coast, west of the island on which São Luís stands. The Mearim and its tributaries bring fresh water into the bay, while powerful tides move through its channels and around low islands. Its wide entrance opens onto the Atlantic; farther inland the waters narrow toward the rivers, creating a route between the coast and the Maranhão interior.
simp_chinese: 圣马科斯湾是马拉尼昂海岸的一处宽阔河口，位于圣路易斯所在岛屿以西。梅阿林河及其支流将淡水带入海湾，强劲潮汐则穿过水道、绕行低矮岛屿。宽阔湾口向大西洋敞开，内陆方向的水域逐渐收窄并通向河流，构成海岸与马拉尼昂腹地之间的通道。

english: São Miguel, the largest of the Azores, lies in the eastern group of the archipelago. Its volcanic shores enclose a landscape of hills and fertile land. Portuguese settlers arrived in the 1440s under Gonçalo Velho Cabral. Vila Franca do Campo became the early center of the island, but a devastating earthquake struck it in 1522. Ponta Delgada on the southern coast grew into an important port and center of commerce.
simp_chinese: 圣米格尔岛是亚速尔群岛最大的岛屿，位于群岛东部。火山海岸环绕着起伏的山地和肥沃土地。十五世纪四十年代，葡萄牙移民在贡萨洛·韦略·卡布拉尔率领下到来。自由镇成为岛上早期中心，却在1522年遭到地震重创；南岸的蓬塔德尔加达则发展为重要的港口和商业中心。

english: São Nicolau is a mountainous island in the northern group of Cape Verde, between Santa Luzia and Sal. Diogo Afonso reached it in 1461 or 1462, but settlement began in the seventeenth century. Pirate attacks led the inhabitants to abandon the coastal settlement of Porto de Lapa in 1653 and establish Ribeira Brava inland. In 1786 the latter became the seat of the Roman Catholic diocese of Santiago de Cabo Verde, bringing an important ecclesiastical office to the island.
simp_chinese: 圣尼古拉岛是佛得角北部群岛中的山地岛屿，位于圣卢西亚岛与萨尔岛之间。迪奥戈·阿丰索于1461或1462年抵达，直到十七世纪才开始有人定居。海盗袭击迫使居民在1653年放弃海岸聚落拉帕港，转而在内陆建立里贝拉布拉瓦。1786年，佛得角圣地亚哥天主教教区的主教座迁至此处，使岛上拥有了一处重要的教会驻地。

english: São Roque lies in the wooded hills west of São Paulo. The settlement developed around a chapel and estate associated with Pedro Vaz de Barros, known as Vaz-Guaçu, who received land in this interior country. Its location placed it among the farms and routes that spread outward from the plateau settlements during the seventeenth century, as colonial families sought land beyond São Paulo.
simp_chinese: 圣罗克位于圣保罗以西林木覆盖的丘陵中。聚落围绕一座小教堂和佩德罗·瓦斯·迪巴罗斯的庄园发展；他又称瓦斯瓜苏，曾在这片内陆地区获得土地。十七世纪，殖民家庭在圣保罗以外寻找土地，农庄与道路从高原聚落向外扩展，圣罗克便位于这一网络之中。

english: São Sebastião lies on the northern coast of São Paulo, facing the island that shares its name across a sheltered channel. Forested mountains rise close behind the narrow coastal plain. The Portuguese settlement became a town in the seventeenth century, serving a region whose economy included sugar production and whale oil. Its anchorage connected the coastal community to the shipping routes of southeastern Brazil.
simp_chinese: 圣塞巴斯蒂昂位于圣保罗北部海岸，隔着受掩护的水道与同名岛屿相望。森林覆盖的群山紧逼狭窄的海岸平原。葡萄牙聚落在十七世纪升格为镇，周围地区的经济包括制糖和鲸油生产。这里的锚地将海岸社区与巴西东南部的航运路线联系起来。

english: São Sebastião do Paraíso began in the rural hills of southern Minas Gerais. In 1821 the Antunes Maciel family donated land for a chapel dedicated to Saint Sebastian. Families living near the Fazenda da Serra raised the first modest chapel, and a settlement grew around it. The church gave the community its patron and a meeting place amid the farms of the surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 圣塞巴斯蒂昂杜帕拉伊索兴起于米纳斯吉拉斯南部的乡间丘陵。1821年，安图内斯·马西埃尔家族捐出土地，用于修建供奉圣塞巴斯蒂昂的小教堂。居住在山庄附近的家庭建起了第一座简朴教堂，聚落随后在周围形成。教堂为社区提供了主保和相聚之所，四周则散布着农场。

english:
São Tomé is a mountainous island near the equator in the Gulf of Guinea. Portuguese settlers made it a center of sugar cultivation, importing enslaved Africans to work plantations and mills. The town of São Tomé became the seat of the colony, with a cathedral and a fort overlooking its harbor. Its wealth rested on forced labor, and resistance shaped the island's history as surely as the commerce that carried its sugar overseas.

Álvaro Caminha established a Portuguese settlement in 1493. During the sixteenth century São Tomé became a major sugar producer, drawing captives from places including Benin, Kongo and Angola. Some fled the plantations for the forested interior and formed communities in the mountains. In 1595 an enslaved man named Amador led a major uprising against colonial rule; plantations were attacked and the revolt was eventually suppressed. Four years later a Dutch fleet captured and sacked the town. Sugar production declined as Brazilian plantations expanded, but the island remained involved in Atlantic trade in enslaved people.
simp_chinese:
圣多美是几内亚湾赤道附近的一座山地岛屿。葡萄牙殖民者将它发展为糖业中心，输入被奴役的非洲人在种植园和糖坊劳动。圣多美城成为殖民地的中心，港口上方有主教座堂和堡垒。岛上的财富建立在强迫劳动之上，抵抗与将蔗糖运往海外的商业一样，深刻塑造了这里的历史。

1493年，阿尔瓦罗·卡米尼亚建立葡萄牙聚落。十六世纪，圣多美成为重要产糖地，从贝宁、刚果和安哥拉等地输入被俘者。一些人逃离种植园，进入森林覆盖的腹地，在山中建立社群。1595年，一名叫阿马多尔的被奴役者领导大规模起义，攻击种植园，最终遭到镇压。四年后，荷兰舰队攻占并洗劫了城镇。随着巴西种植园扩张，岛上糖业衰落，但圣多美仍参与大西洋奴隶贸易。

english:
The waters around Saona lie off southeastern Hispaniola, where reefs, shallow approaches, and island shores form part of the Caribbean maritime world. Fish, shellfish, and other resources supported Indigenous use alongside nearby cultivated land. Canoes linked islands and mainland settlements through knowledge of currents, weather, and safe landings. The coast offered useful connections without making every approach suitable for larger unfamiliar vessels.

The Taíno knew the island as Adamanay. Columbus landed there in 1494, and by 1500 its Taíno inhabitants supplied much of Santo Domingo's cassava. Spanish arrival transformed the wider Taíno world through labour demands, violence and disease, disrupting communities as colonial settlement expanded. Later maritime traffic connected Hispaniola with wider Caribbean routes, carrying provisions, goods and people under changing political conditions.
simp_chinese:
绍纳岛周围水域位于伊斯帕尼奥拉东南，珊瑚礁、浅水入口和岛屿岸线构成加勒比海洋世界。鱼、贝类及其他资源，同附近耕地一起支持原住民利用。独木舟依靠海流、天气和安全登陆知识，联系岛屿及大陆聚落。海岸提供联系，却未使每处入口都适合陌生大船。

泰诺人称此岛为阿达马奈。哥伦布于1494年登岛，到1500年前后，岛上泰诺人供应圣多明各大部分木薯。西班牙到来带来的劳役、暴力与疾病改变了更广的泰诺世界，殖民定居扩张使社群遭受严重破坏。后来海上交通将伊斯帕尼奥拉同更广的加勒比航路相连，在变化的政治条件下运送粮食、货物和人口。

english: West of the lower Volga, shallow lakes occupy depressions between the river and the Ergeni hills. The Sarpinsky lakes are remnants of an ancient Volga channel, set among dry steppe and seasonal grazing grounds. Their water and reedbeds provided a contrast to the open grassland around them. Kalmyk pastoral communities moved through this country, while settlements such as Zamyany developed nearer the Volga's high bank during the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 伏尔加河下游以西，浅湖占据河流与叶尔根尼丘陵之间的洼地。萨尔帕湖群是古代伏尔加河道的遗存，周围是干草原和季节性牧场。湖水与芦苇丛同开阔草地形成对照。卡尔梅克牧民社群穿行于这片土地；十八世纪，扎米亚内等聚落则在更靠近伏尔加河高岸的地方发展起来。

english:
Saparua is one of the Lease Islands east of Ambon, in the clove-growing heart of the central Moluccas. The Dutch East India Company concentrated clove cultivation in Ambon and the neighboring islands as it sought to control the spice trade. Fort Duurstede, overlooking Saparua's coast, became a center of Dutch defense and administration. Its walls also sheltered a store for spices before their dispatch, tying the fort directly to the Company's commerce.

The more permanent fort was built around 1690–1691 under Governor Nicolaas Schaghen. Britain occupied Saparua in 1796 and again in 1810 before the islands returned to Dutch rule. In 1817 a revolt led by Thomas Matulessy, remembered as Pattimura, captured Duurstede, making the fort a landmark of resistance to renewed colonial authority.
simp_chinese:
萨帕鲁阿是安汶以东的利亚瑟群岛之一，位于摩鹿加中部丁香种植的核心地带。荷兰东印度公司试图控制香料贸易，将丁香种植集中于安汶及附近岛屿。俯瞰萨帕鲁阿海岸的杜尔斯泰德堡成为荷兰的防御与行政中心，墙内还曾储存等待运出的香料，使堡垒与公司的商业直接相连。

较为坚固的堡垒于1690至1691年前后在总督尼古拉斯·斯哈亨治下建成。英国于1796年和1810年两度占领萨帕鲁阿，诸岛后来重归荷兰。1817年，托马斯·马图莱西领导的起义攻占杜尔斯泰德；他被后人称为帕蒂穆拉，这座堡垒也成为抵抗殖民统治恢复的标志。

english: The Sape Strait runs along the eastern end of Sumbawa, separating it from the islands towards Flores. It links the Flores Sea with the Sumba Strait, passing a coast marked by the bays and headlands of eastern Sumbawa. Komodo and other smaller islands lie east of the passage, breaking up the waters between the larger islands of the Lesser Sundas.
simp_chinese: 萨佩海峡沿松巴哇岛东端延伸，将其与通往弗洛勒斯方向的岛屿分开。海峡连接弗洛勒斯海和松巴海峡，沿岸是松巴哇东部的海湾与岬角。科莫多等小岛位于水道以东，使小巽他群岛中较大岛屿之间的海面变得曲折。

english:
Sapelo is one of the wooded barrier islands off the Georgia coast, surrounded by tidal marshes and creeks. Its name preserves that of Sapala, a Guale community known to the Spanish. The island's inhabitants drew on the resources of both land and sea, while waterways linked it to the neighbouring islands and mainland.

Spanish missionaries established San José de Sapala on the island. During the seventeenth century, attacks by raiders drove people from other Guale towns to seek refuge on Sapelo, including the community of Santa Catalina after 1680. In 1684 the Spanish withdrew south under continuing pressure. In the early nineteenth century Thomas Spalding developed plantations on the island, where enslaved people grew cotton and sugarcane. Among them was Bilali Muhammad, a West African Muslim who wrote a manuscript on Islamic law.
simp_chinese:
萨佩洛是佐治亚海岸外林木繁茂的障壁岛之一，周围环绕着潮汐沼泽与溪流。岛名保留了西班牙人记载的瓜莱社群萨帕拉之名。居民利用陆地和海洋资源，水道则将岛屿与邻近岛屿及大陆连接起来。

西班牙传教士在岛上建立萨帕拉圣若瑟传教站。十七世纪，掠夺者的袭击迫使其他瓜莱村镇的居民前往萨佩洛避难，1680年以后抵达的还包括圣卡塔利娜社群。1684年，在持续的压力下，西班牙人撤往南方。十九世纪初，托马斯·斯波尔丁在岛上经营种植园，被奴役的人种植棉花和甘蔗。其中有来自西非的穆斯林比拉利·穆罕默德，他写下了一部伊斯兰法手稿。

english:
The Saponi were a people of the Virginia and Carolina Piedmont, related to the Tutelo and other Indigenous communities of the inland rivers. In 1670 John Lederer visited a town called Sapon, and the following year another English expedition passed through Saponi villages. Warfare and colonial expansion led communities to move toward the Dan and Roanoke rivers, where they settled near the Occaneechi.

In 1714 Virginia's governor Alexander Spotswood established a reservation at Fort Christanna for the Saponi and allied peoples. They sought protection there from attacks by the Haudenosaunee. Though the fort was later abandoned by the colony, some people remained in the district before moving away in smaller groups. In 1753 the Cayuga adopted Saponi and Tutelo into their nation within the Haudenosaunee Confederacy.
simp_chinese:
萨波尼人生活在弗吉尼亚与卡罗来纳的皮德蒙特地区，与图特洛人及内陆河流沿岸的其他原住民社群关系密切。1670年，约翰·莱德勒到访了一座名为萨蓬的城镇；次年，另一支英国远征队经过萨波尼村落。战争和殖民扩张促使社群向丹河与罗阿诺克河迁移，在奥卡尼奇人附近定居。

1714年，弗吉尼亚总督亚历山大·斯波茨伍德在克里斯坦纳堡为萨波尼人及盟友设立保留地，居民希望借此躲避豪德诺索尼人的袭击。虽然殖民地后来放弃堡垒，一些人仍留在附近，随后陆续分小群迁走。1753年，豪德诺索尼联盟中的卡尤加人将萨波尼人与图特洛人接纳为本族成员。

english: Sappah, a Dakota name meaning “black,” was used for the Black River of western Wisconsin. The river rises in the inland country and flows southwest toward the Mississippi, gathering streams from forests and wetlands along its course. Near its mouth it spreads into channels and backwaters beside the great river. The name of the river recalls the dark water that runs through a broad watershed between the Wisconsin and Chippewa rivers.
simp_chinese: 萨帕是达科他语中“黑色”的意思，曾用来称呼威斯康星西部的黑河。河流发源于内陆，向西南流往密西西比河，沿途汇集森林与湿地间的溪流。靠近河口时，水流在大河边展开成河道与回水区。河名使人想起深色的河水，它流经威斯康星河与奇佩瓦河之间的广阔流域。

english:
The Saponi were a Siouan-speaking people of the wooded interior between Virginia and Carolina. Their communities moved between the rivers of the region in the face of conflict and changing alliances. In 1670 the traveller John Lederer visited a village he called Sapon; by the beginning of the next century the Saponi were living farther south on the Yadkin River.

In 1701 John Lawson visited their fortified town on the Yadkin, then called the Sapona River. He found it standing in a large clearing and described a leader and council, as well as a local healer who kept herbs and medicines. The Saponi later moved again toward Virginia, where they joined other Indigenous communities around Fort Christanna in the early eighteenth century.
simp_chinese:
萨波尼人使用苏语族语言，居住在弗吉尼亚与卡罗来纳之间的内陆林地。面对冲突和不断变化的联盟，他们在这一地区的河流之间迁徙。1670年，旅行者约翰·莱德勒造访了一个他称为萨波恩的村庄；到下世纪初，萨波尼人已向南迁至亚德金河畔。

1701年，约翰·劳森造访了他们在亚德金河畔的设防村镇，当时这条河被称为萨波纳河。村镇坐落在一片宽阔的空地上；劳森记载了当地的首领和议事会，以及一位储存草药的医者。此后萨波尼人再次迁往弗吉尼亚，十八世纪初与其他原住民社群汇聚于克里斯坦纳堡附近。

sources.title: HA-081 High Plains Sappony NCVA Christie Indian Settlement 2017 WM report.pdf

english: Sapporo lies on the Ishikari plain, beside rivers whose salmon sustained numerous Ainu settlements. Its name has been explained from Ainu words for either a large dry river or a river with extensive reed marshes. In the late eighteenth century, trading districts established along the Toyohira and other rivers brought Ainu communities into closer commerce with the Matsumae domain. As merchants took over the fisheries, many Ainu became laborers in them. The shogunate placed western Ezo, including Sapporo, under direct control in 1807.
simp_chinese: 札幌坐落在石狩平原，河流中的鲑鱼滋养着众多阿伊努聚落。地名有不同的阿伊努语解释，一说意为干涸的大河，一说指芦苇沼泽广阔的河流。十八世纪后半叶，松前藩在丰平川等地设立交易场所，使当地阿伊努人与藩的商业往来更加密切。随着商人接管渔场，许多阿伊努人被迫转为渔业劳动者。1807年，幕府直接管辖包括札幌在内的西虾夷地。

english: The Sapudi Islands lie in the Java Sea between Madura and the Kangean Islands. Sapudi and Raas are among the larger islands in a group linked by short sea crossings; a dialect of Madurese is spoken there. Their wider setting was shaped by the history of Madura, conquered by Mataram in 1624 and affected by Dutch intervention in the Javanese succession struggles of the early eighteenth century. These events concern the larger regional political world and do not by themselves establish what happened on each small island. For island communities, boats and the channels between neighbouring shores formed the practical connections through which people and goods could move.
simp_chinese: 萨普迪群岛位于爪哇海，处在马都拉岛与康厄安群岛之间。萨普迪和拉阿斯是其中较大的岛屿，岛民使用马都拉语的一种方言，短途海路连接着邻近岛岸。群岛所处的广大区域受到马都拉历史影响：马打兰于1624年征服马都拉，十八世纪初爪哇继承斗争又带来荷兰干预。这些事件属于区域政治背景，不能据此断定每座小岛上的具体经历。对岛屿社群而言，船只和岛间水道是人员与货物流动的实际联系。

english: The uplands around Franca lie between the Pardo and Sapucaí river systems in the interior of São Paulo. A road toward Goiás crossed this country as prospectors and settlers travelled inland. A parish dedicated to Nossa Senhora da Conceição was established in the early nineteenth century, and the settlement was raised to a town in 1824, becoming a centre for the surrounding rural district.
simp_chinese: 弗兰卡周围的高地位于圣保罗内陆帕尔多河与萨普卡伊河水系之间。探矿者和定居者向内陆行进时，通往戈亚斯的道路穿过这里。十九世纪初，当地建立圣母无染原罪堂区；1824年聚落升为城镇，成为周围乡村地区的中心。

english:
Saqqa belongs to the southwestern Ethiopian highlands associated with Ennarea and the wider Gibe country. The region's varied elevations supported cultivated land, pasture, and wooded areas, allowing communities to obtain different products within relatively short distances. Rainfall and fertile soils sustained farming, while routes through valleys connected local markets with neighbouring highland and lowland societies. Livestock and agricultural goods moved alongside more specialized products in exchanges shaped by both terrain and political relationships.

Ennarea formed part of a southern Ethiopian world of kingdoms, tribute, and long-distance commerce. In 1825 Abba Bagibo made Saqqa the capital of Limmu-Ennarea. The town grew as a marketplace where Muslim traders bought gold, coffee and ivory from the wider Gibe region. Its position linked southern suppliers with merchants from more distant Ethiopian centres.
simp_chinese:
萨加属于埃塞俄比亚西南高地，与恩纳雷亚及更广的吉贝地区相联系。海拔差异使耕地、牧场和林地相互交错，社群在相对短的距离内便可获得不同产品。降雨与肥沃土壤支持农业，谷地路线则把地方市场同邻近高地、低地社会连接起来。牲畜和农产与较为特殊的商品一同流通，交换同时受到地形与政治关系影响。

恩纳雷亚参与埃塞俄比亚南部由王国、贡赋和长途商业构成的世界。1825年，阿巴·巴吉博将萨加定为利穆—恩纳雷亚的都城。此地逐渐成为市场，穆斯林商人在这里购买来自更广大吉贝地区的黄金、咖啡和象牙。城镇将南方供应者与来自更远埃塞俄比亚中心的商人联系起来。

english: Shakra is a town of al-Washm in the Najd plateau, south of Ushayqir and among the settlements of the historic Yamama country. Its fortified town and palm gardens lay on the route through central Arabia toward Diriyah. During Ibrahim Pasha's campaign against the first Saudi state in 1818, the people of Shakra prepared for siege. A Najdi chronicle describes the digging of a wide ditch, the construction of a wall beside it and the gathering of food for a long defence. After the Egyptian army advanced from Qasim and bombarded the town, its inhabitants sought terms. Ibrahim continued to Dhurma and then to the Saudi capital at Diriyah.
simp_chinese: 沙格拉是内志高原瓦什姆地区的城镇，位于乌沙伊吉尔以南，属于历史上亚马马地区的聚落。设防城镇和枣椰园坐落在穿过阿拉伯中部、通向德拉伊耶的道路上。1818年，易卜拉欣帕夏进攻第一沙特国时，沙格拉的居民准备守城。内志编年史记载，人们挖掘宽阔壕沟，在旁筑墙，并囤积粮食以备长期围困。埃及军队从卡西姆推进并炮击城镇后，居民请求议和。易卜拉欣随后继续进军达尔马，最后抵达沙特都城德拉伊耶。

english: Sar Mashhad lies in the hills of western Fars, south of Kazerun. A Sasanian rock relief cut into the cliff depicts King Bahram II fighting lions while protecting figures beside him. One of those figures is the priest Kartir, whose inscription accompanies the scene. The dramatic carving joins royal courage with religious and dynastic authority, themes familiar from other Sasanian monuments in Fars. It remains a striking mark of the ancient kingdom in a landscape of steep ridges and valleys.
simp_chinese: 萨尔马什哈德位于法尔斯西部丘陵，在卡泽伦以南。悬崖上的萨珊岩刻描绘巴赫拉姆二世与狮子搏斗，同时保护身旁的人物。其中一人是祭司卡尔提尔，浮雕旁还有他的铭文。这幅戏剧性画面将王者勇武与宗教、王朝权威结合起来，这些主题也见于法尔斯其他萨珊纪念物。在层叠山岭与谷地之间，岩刻留下古代王国鲜明的印记。

english: Sar-e Pol lies on the river descending from the valleys of Kohistanat toward the plains south of Sheberghan. Its name means the head of the bridge, recalling a crossing in a region where mountain waters spread into lower country. From the early sixteenth to the middle of the eighteenth century the surrounding territory belonged to the realm of Bukhara. Sar-e Pol later formed one of the local Uzbek khanates of the northern Afghan country known as the Four Provinces.
simp_chinese: 萨尔普勒位于一条河流旁，河水从科希斯塔纳特山谷流向希比尔甘以南平原。地名意为“桥头”，使人想起山水流入低地之处的渡口。十六世纪初至十八世纪中叶，周边地区属于布哈拉的统治范围。萨尔普勒后来成为阿富汗北部“四省”地区的地方乌兹别克汗国之一。

english:
Sar-e Sang lies high in the Hindu Kush above the Kokcha valley, amid the celebrated lapis lazuli mines of Badakhshan. The deep blue stone, often flecked with golden pyrite and white calcite, has been extracted here since antiquity and carried far beyond the mountains. Before explosives were used, miners heated the rock with fires and cracked it by throwing cold water over it.

In the thirteenth century Marco Polo described a mountain in Badakhshan where exceptionally fine blue stone was found, though he did not visit the mines himself. Ground lapis supplied the costly pigment known as ultramarine, prized by painters as well as by makers of ornaments and precious objects. The difficult paths from the mines into the Kokcha valley joined the stone to trading networks extending across Asia and beyond.
simp_chinese:
萨尔桑格高踞科克恰河谷上方的兴都库什山中，是巴达赫尚著名的青金石矿区。深蓝色石料常带有金色黄铁矿斑点与白色方解石，自古在此开采，并被运往远方。使用炸药之前，矿工先用火烧热岩石，再泼冷水使其开裂。

十三世纪，马可·波罗描述了巴达赫尚一座出产上等蓝色宝石的山，虽然他本人并未到访矿场。青金石磨碎后可制成昂贵的群青颜料，受到画师以及首饰、珍贵器物工匠的重视。从矿山通往科克恰河谷的崎岖山路，使宝石进入横跨亚洲及更远地区的贸易网络。

english: Sara' is a village in the country south of Ha'il, in the northern Arabian interior. The surrounding district belongs to the homeland of the Shammar, whose branches occupy settlements and grazing lands across this dry region. The village shares its name with places farther south and west in Arabia, but is distinguished by its position near the Ha'il country and its association with the Aslam branch of Shammar.
simp_chinese: 萨拉是阿拉伯北部内陆哈伊勒以南地区的一处村落。周边属于舍迈尔人的故地，其各支系在干旱地区的聚落和牧地生活。阿拉伯半岛更南和更西的地方也有同名地点，而此村以接近哈伊勒、与舍迈尔人的阿斯拉姆支系有关而可加区别。

english:
Sara Sara belongs to the high volcanic landscape of the southern Peruvian Andes, where mountains held practical and religious importance for surrounding communities. Pastures supported camelids, while cultivation occupied lower or more sheltered areas. Movement between elevations allowed households to combine products from different ecological zones. Roads and local paths linked villages with grazing areas, markets, and places understood through sacred relationships with the landscape.

Sara Sara was a sacred mountain to local communities before and during Inca rule. Inca offerings and a burial found near its summit testify to its ritual significance. Spanish conquest later transformed political authority and introduced new institutions and Christian practices, while Indigenous communities continued to manage land and collective obligations under colonial demands.
simp_chinese:
萨拉萨拉属于秘鲁南部安第斯高山火山景观，山岳对周围社群同时具有实际和宗教意义。草场饲养美洲驼等动物，较低或避风土地则用于耕作。居民在不同海拔之间移动，结合各生态带产品。道路和地方小径连接村庄、牧场、市场，以及通过神圣关系理解的景观地点，生产与信仰因此共同参与地域生活。

印加统治以前和期间，萨拉萨拉都是当地社群敬奉的圣山。山顶附近发现的印加祭品和墓葬，显示其仪式意义。西班牙征服后来改变政治权威，带来新机构和基督教实践；原住民社群则在殖民要求下继续管理土地与集体义务。

english: Sara Sara rises above the southern Peruvian highlands between Lake Parinacochas and the Ocoña River. The great volcano bears glaciers on its upper slopes, while traces of former lava flows extend into the surrounding country. For the Incas its summit was a place of ceremony: a young person and offerings were placed high on the mountain in a capacocha rite, linking this remote peak to the religious world of the empire.
simp_chinese: 萨拉萨拉火山耸立于秘鲁南部高地，位于帕里纳科查斯湖与奥科尼亚河之间。高坡覆盖冰川，昔日熔岩流的痕迹延伸到周围山地。对印加人而言，山顶是举行仪式的地方：一名少女与供品被安置在高山上，作为卡帕科查祭仪的一部分，使这座偏远山峰与帝国的宗教世界相连。

english:
Sarab stands on the road between Tabriz and Ardabil, in the uplands south of the great volcanic mass of Sabalan. Medieval Arab geographers called the town Sarat, while the later form Sarab also gave its name to the river. Its position placed it among the towns of eastern Azarbaijan through which travellers crossed the plateau, between the mountain pastures and the neighbouring settled districts.

In the late eighteenth century Sarab was the seat of a local khanate. When Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar invaded Azarbaijan in 1791, Sadiq Khan withdrew from Tabriz to defend Sarab. He was defeated, and the Qajar army ravaged the town and its surrounding countryside in the course of the struggle to bring the region under its rule.
simp_chinese:
萨拉布位于大不里士通往阿尔达比勒的道路上，坐落在萨巴兰火山南面的高地。中世纪阿拉伯地理学家称此城为萨拉特，后来的名称萨拉布也被用作河名。它是东阿塞拜疆高原上旅行者途经的城镇之一，连接山地牧场与邻近定居地区。

十八世纪末，萨拉布是一个地方汗国的驻地。1791年，阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔入侵阿塞拜疆，萨迪克汗从大不里士退回萨拉布防守。他战败后，卡扎尔军队在争夺这一地区的过程中蹂躏了城镇及周围乡村。

english: Sarab-e Dowreh lies in the Chegeni country west of Khorramabad, among the folded ranges of Lorestan. Springs and streams water valleys between the ridges, while the higher slopes offer grazing ground. Oak woods and open pasture form part of the landscape of the Zagros, where routes through the valleys connect small settlements with the larger towns of the region.
simp_chinese: 萨拉布杜雷位于霍拉马巴德以西的切盖尼地区，坐落在卢里斯坦的褶皱山脉之间。泉水和溪流滋养山脊之间的谷地，高处山坡则提供牧场。橡树林与开阔草场构成扎格罗斯山地景观的一部分，穿过谷地的道路将小聚落与当地较大的城镇连接起来。

english: Saraburi lies east of the Chao Phraya plain, where the Pa Sak River approaches the hills leading towards the Khorat Plateau. The town is traditionally associated with the reign of King Maha Chakkraphat of Ayutthaya in the sixteenth century. To its north stands Wat Phra Phutthabat, built under King Songtham in 1624 around a mark in the rock revered as the Buddha's footprint. A shrine over the footprint became an important destination for royal and popular pilgrimage.
simp_chinese: 沙拉武里位于湄南河平原以东，巴萨河在这里接近通往呵叻高原的丘陵。当地传统将城邑的建立归于十六世纪阿瑜陀耶的玛哈差卡帕王时期。城北的佛足寺由颂谭王于1624年兴建，围绕一处被奉为佛足印的岩石凹痕而建。足印上方的殿堂成为王室与民众朝圣的重要目的地。

english: Sarahan stands above the Sutlej in the western Himalayas. It was the summer capital of the kingdom of Bushahr, whose rulers revered the goddess Bhimakali as their family deity. Her temple at Sarahan, said to have been founded in the thirteenth century, is counted among the sacred Shakta pithas. Rampur, lower in the valley, served as the kingdom's winter capital.
simp_chinese: 萨拉汉位于西喜马拉雅山中，俯瞰萨特莱杰河。它曾是布沙赫尔王国的夏都；该国统治者将毗摩迦梨女神尊为家族守护神。萨拉汉的女神庙据说创建于十三世纪，被视为性力派的圣地之一。王国的冬都兰普尔则位于河谷较低处。

english:
Sarai al-Jadid, the New Palace, was the capital of the Golden Horde in the age of Özbeg and Jani Beg, a city of the lower Volga beside the Akhtuba arm of the river. Italian sources say it was laid out shortly before 1338. Khans received Russian princes here and granted them their patents of rule, and the city had mosques, an Orthodox bishop, a mint and a large market. In the winter of 1356–57 Jani Beg's army took Tabriz, and in 1357 Metropolitan Alexius of Moscow made the long journey to Sarai to heal the khan's wife.

The prosperity ended in the Great Troubles that followed Jani Beg's death, when rival khans passed the city between them after 1361. Timur's army wrecked it in 1395. Coins were still struck in a small way in the early 15th century, and the traveller Afanasy Nikitin passed by around 1469, but river raiders from Viatka sacked it in 1471. In 1502 the Crimean khan Mengli I Giray, fresh from defeating the Great Horde on the Sula, destroyed it to show that he was the true heir of the Horde.
simp_chinese:
萨莱·杰迪德意为“新宫”，是月即别与札尼别时代金帐汗国的都城，坐落在伏尔加河下游，濒临阿赫图巴河汊。意大利文献说它建于1338年前不久。汗王在这里接见罗斯诸公，授予他们统治的诏书；城中有清真寺、东正教主教、造币厂和大集市。1356至1357年冬，札尼别的军队攻占大不里士；1357年，莫斯科都主教阿列克谢长途跋涉来到萨莱，为汗的妻子治病。

札尼别死后的“大动乱”终结了这一繁荣，1361年后，各路汗位争夺者轮番占据此城。1395年，帖木儿的军队将其破坏。15世纪初这里仍有少量铸币，约1469年旅行家阿法纳西·尼基京曾经过此地，但1471年来自维亚特卡的河上劫掠者洗劫了它。1502年，克里米亚汗明里一世·格来在苏拉河击败大帐汗国之后，为显示自己才是汗国的真正继承者，将萨莱彻底摧毁。

english:
Sarakhs was an oasis town on the Tejen River, between Nishapur and Merv. Its position made it a major stopping place on the great roads through Khorasan. In the Seljuk period it became known for its builders and brick architecture, and the tomb of the Sufi Abu'l Fazl, known as Sarakhs Baba, stood among the monuments of the oasis.

Sarakhs was one of the places where the Seljuk Turks established themselves after entering Khorasan in 1035. The town later suffered during the Mongol invasions, yet its place on the river and the road ensured that the name endured. Tombs and ruined buildings recall the scholars, craftsmen and travellers who once made the oasis part of the urban world of medieval Khorasan.
simp_chinese:
萨拉赫斯是泰詹河上的绿洲城镇，位于内沙布尔与木鹿之间，是穿越呼罗珊的大道上的停驻地。塞尔柱时期，这里以建筑师和砖建筑闻名；被称为萨拉赫斯巴巴的苏菲阿布勒·法兹勒之墓，也是绿洲中的重要建筑之一。

1035年塞尔柱突厥人进入呼罗珊后，萨拉赫斯是他们最初据有的地点之一。城镇后来在蒙古入侵中受创，但河畔道路上的位置使它的名字延续下来。陵墓和废墟令人想起学者、工匠和旅人曾使这片绿洲成为中世纪呼罗珊城市世界的一部分。

english: The Sarangani Islands lie south of Mindanao, looking across the Celebes Sea toward the Sangihe archipelago. Their inhabitants include Sangil communities whose origins lie among the islands to the south. Through contact with Sangihe and the Muslim communities of Mindanao and Sulu, Islam became part of Sangil life. In 1543 the Spanish expedition of Ruy López de Villalobos named Sarangani Island Antonia, after the patron who had commissioned the voyage.
simp_chinese: 萨兰加尼群岛位于棉兰老岛南方，隔西里伯斯海与桑义赫群岛相望。岛上居民包括源自南方诸岛的桑吉尔社群；通过与桑义赫以及棉兰老和苏禄穆斯林社群的联系，伊斯兰教成为桑吉尔人生活的一部分。1543年，鲁伊·洛佩斯·德·比利亚洛沃斯的西班牙远征队以资助航行者之名称萨兰加尼岛为安东尼亚。

english: Sarangani Bay cuts into the southern tip of Mindanao, opening towards the Celebes Sea. The bay lies west of Davao Gulf, with coastal plains and mountains behind its shores. Its sheltered waters support fishing communities, while the sea beyond links southern Mindanao with the islands towards Sulawesi.
simp_chinese: 萨兰加尼湾凹入棉兰老岛南端，向苏拉威西海敞开。海湾位于达沃湾以西，沿岸后方有平原和山地。较为隐蔽的水域支持渔民社群，湾外的海洋则将棉兰老南部与通往苏拉威西的诸岛相连。

english: The Sarangani Strait separates southern Mindanao from the islands of Balut and Sarangani. Balut is a volcanic island, rising above the water south of the larger coast, with its neighbour farther east. The passage opens towards the Celebes Sea and the island routes leading south towards Indonesia.
simp_chinese: 萨兰加尼海峡将棉兰老岛南部与巴卢特、萨兰加尼诸岛分开。巴卢特是一座火山岛，在大岛海岸以南升起，其邻岛位于更东方。水道通向苏拉威西海及向南延伸至印度尼西亚的岛间航路。

english: Sarangarh was the capital of a small state in eastern Chhattisgarh, ruled by a Raj Gond dynasty. It lay in the country south of Raigarh, near the Mahanadi basin. The ruling family gave the town a royal centre and preserved distinctive ceremonial traditions, including a Dussehra celebration in which participants attempt to climb a fort made of earth. Local accounts connect the contest with the recognition of bravery by the rulers of Sarangarh.
simp_chinese: 萨兰加尔是恰蒂斯加尔东部一个小国的都城，由拉杰贡德王朝统治。它位于赖加尔以南、摩诃那迪河流域附近。统治家族使城镇成为王室中心，并保留了独特的仪式传统；杜塞赫拉节期间，人们会争相攀登一座泥土筑成的象征性堡垒。当地说法将这场竞赛与萨兰加尔统治者对勇士的表彰联系起来。

english: Sarangpur stands on the Kali Sindh River in Malwa. It is said to have been founded by Shaikh Sarang, an amir of Sultan Firuz Shah Tughlaq. The town was the scene of conflict between the rulers of Malwa and their neighbours: Rana Kumbha of Mewar defeated Mahmud Khalji there and took the sultan prisoner. Later Baz Bahadur, the ruler of Malwa, was defeated at Sarangpur by the forces of the Mughal emperor Akbar.
simp_chinese: 萨朗普尔坐落在摩腊婆的卡利辛德河畔，相传由苏丹菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克的埃米尔谢赫·萨朗建立。这里曾是摩腊婆统治者与邻邦争战的场所：梅瓦尔的拉纳·昆巴在此击败马哈茂德·卡尔吉，并俘获了这位苏丹。后来，摩腊婆统治者巴兹·巴哈杜尔也在萨朗普尔败于莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴的军队。

english:
Saransk grew at the meeting of the Saranka and Insar rivers in the Mordvin country. Founded as a wooden fortress on the southeastern frontier of the Russian state, it became an administrative and trading centre for a region inhabited by Russians, Mordvins and Tatars. Roads and river valleys connected it with towns across the middle Volga and central Russia.

Prince Savely Kozlovsky built the first fort in 1641 as part of the Atemar defensive line. In 1653 the administration of the line moved from Atemar to Saransk, and the fortress was enlarged with a lower section across the Saranka. Cossacks, streltsy and gunners formed its service population. The fort was besieged and taken during Stenka Razin's uprising in 1670, becoming a base for his followers.

As the frontier moved away, Saransk developed as a town of merchants and craftspeople. Its fairs drew trade from Kazan, Moscow, Nizhny Novgorod and other cities. In July 1774 Yemelyan Pugachev entered Saransk and found support among its inhabitants. The stone Church of St John the Evangelist, built in 1693, remained a landmark of the town as its role changed from frontier defence to administration and commerce. The old fort had contained storehouses for arms and salt, officials’ offices and small wooden churches; the civilian town that grew around it inherited the crossroads created by the frontier garrison.
simp_chinese:
萨兰斯克兴起于莫尔多瓦地区萨兰卡河与因萨尔河交汇处。它作为俄罗斯国家东南边境的木堡建立，后来成为俄罗斯人、莫尔多瓦人和鞑靼人共同生活地区的行政与贸易中心。道路和河谷将它与中伏尔加及俄罗斯中部诸城连接起来。

1641年，萨韦利·科兹洛夫斯基亲王修建了第一座堡垒，作为阿特马尔防线的一部分。1653年，防线管理机构从阿特马尔迁到萨兰斯克，堡垒也跨萨兰卡河扩建了下城。哥萨克、射击军和炮手组成服役人口。1670年斯捷潘·拉辛起义期间，堡垒遭围攻并被攻取，成为起义军的据点。

边境远移后，萨兰斯克发展为商人与工匠的城镇。集市吸引来自喀山、莫斯科、下诺夫哥罗德等地的贸易。1774年7月，叶梅利扬·普加乔夫进入萨兰斯克，获得当地居民支持。1693年建成的石砌圣约翰教堂，见证了城镇从边境防御转向行政与商业中心的变化。旧堡垒内曾有军械和盐的仓库、官署及小型木教堂；堡外发展的民间城镇继承了边境驻军形成的交通交汇地位。

english: Sarapul stands on the right bank of the Kama, one of the older settlements of the river country. A population register of 1596 mentions the village of Voznesenskoye, later known as Sarapul, and refers to fishing in the Sarapul and Siva waters. One explanation connects the name with a Chuvash word for a yellow fish or sturgeon, once plentiful in the river. The settlement received a town charter in 1780 and, by the end of the eighteenth century, had become a merchant town known for footwear making.
simp_chinese: 萨拉普尔位于卡马河右岸，是这一河流地区较古老的聚落之一。1596年的人口登记簿提到后来称为萨拉普尔的沃兹涅先斯科耶村，并记载人们在萨拉普尔和锡瓦水域捕鱼。关于地名的一种解释将它与楚瓦什语中黄鱼或鲟鱼的名称联系起来，这类鱼曾在河中十分丰富。聚落于1780年获得城市特许状，到十八世纪末已成为以制鞋闻名的商人城镇。

english: The Sarare flows out of the eastern Andes toward the western Llanos. Near Guasdualito it joins the Uribante, forming the Apure River, which crosses the plains to the Orinoco. The river system links mountain valleys with a broad lowland of savanna and seasonal wetlands. Rainfall in the mountains and plains changes the volume of water through the year, bringing floods to the flat country downstream.
simp_chinese: 萨拉雷河从安第斯山东部流向西部亚诺斯，在瓜斯杜阿利托附近与乌里班特河汇合，形成穿过平原注入奥里诺科河的阿普雷河。水系将山谷与稀树草原和季节性湿地组成的广阔低地相连。山地与平原的降雨使水量随季节变化，也给下游平坦地区带来洪水。

english: Sarashina lies in northern Shinano, near the confluence of the Chikuma and Sai rivers. The plain between these waterways, known as Kawanakajima, became a battlefield in the rivalry between Takeda Shingen of Kai and Uesugi Kenshin of Echigo. Their forces faced one another repeatedly between 1553 and 1564; the fourth encounter, in 1561, was especially fierce and became one of the best-known battles of Japan's age of warring states.
simp_chinese: 更级位于信浓北部，靠近千曲川与犀川的汇合处。两河之间的川中岛平原成为甲斐的武田信玄与越后的上杉谦信争夺的战场。1553年至1564年间，两军多次在此对峙；其中1561年的第四次交锋尤为激烈，成为日本战国时代最著名的战役之一。

english:
Sarata lies in the steppe valley of the river whose name means salty water. The valley came under Ottoman control after the capture of Cetatea Albă and Chilia in 1484, and belonged to an endowment for Mecca and Medina. Ottoman registers mention the river in the sixteenth century; a settlement of the name is known by 1597. In the seventeenth century Evliya Çelebi described a village inhabited chiefly by Tatars and associated it with the tomb of a holy man called Sarı Ata.

After Bessarabia passed to Russia in 1812, German settlers led by Pastor Ignaz Lindl established a new colony at Sarata in 1822. Families from Bavaria and Württemberg built the village on allotted land. Lindl was expelled the following year, and the community's land was subsequently divided among the families.
simp_chinese:
萨拉塔位于同名河流的草原河谷，其河名意为“咸水”。1484年切塔泰阿尔伯和基利亚陷落后，河谷归奥斯曼控制，并属于供养麦加与麦地那的宗教捐产。16世纪奥斯曼户籍屡次提及这条河；到1597年，已有同名聚落。17世纪旅行家埃夫利亚·切莱比描述了一个以鞑靼人为主的村庄，并将其与名叫萨勒·阿塔的圣者墓联系起来。

1812年比萨拉比亚归入俄罗斯后，伊格纳茨·林德尔神父率领的德意志移民于1822年在萨拉塔建立新殖民村。来自巴伐利亚和符腾堡的家庭在分配的土地上建起村庄。林德尔次年被驱逐，社群的土地随后分给各家庭。

english:
Saratoga lies in the upper Hudson valley, where the river passes between wooded hills on its way south. The route north leads toward Lake Champlain and Canada, making the district important to travellers and armies. Dutch and English settlers established farms here, but the frontier remained exposed to conflict with French forces and their allies.

The settlement was burned in 1745 during King George's War. In 1777 British General John Burgoyne advanced south from Canada, while American forces delayed his march by destroying bridges and blocking roads. After battles near Saratoga in September and October, Burgoyne's army retreated and surrendered to General Horatio Gates on 17 October. The victory strengthened the American cause abroad and helped bring France into the war as an ally.
simp_chinese:
萨拉托加位于哈得孙河上游谷地，河水从林木覆盖的丘陵间向南流去。向北的道路通往尚普兰湖与加拿大，因此这一地区对旅人和军队都十分重要。荷兰和英国定居者在此开辟农场，但边疆仍容易受到法国军队及其盟友的袭击。

1745年乔治王战争期间，聚落遭焚毁。1777年，英国将军约翰·伯戈因从加拿大向南推进，美军则拆毁桥梁、阻断道路以迟滞其行军。九月和十月萨拉托加附近的战斗后，伯戈因的军队撤退，并于10月17日向霍雷肖·盖茨将军投降。这场胜利增强了美国事业在海外的声望，并促成法国参战结盟。

english: The forests of the lower Tocantins extend across the eastern Amazon, where broad rivers divide into channels and smaller streams wind through low ground. Dense woodland covers both higher land and the seasonally wet river margins. The Moju and its tributaries form part of this intricate landscape east of the Tocantins, connecting forested interior country with the waters of the Pará estuary.
simp_chinese: 托坎廷斯河下游的森林延伸在亚马逊东部，宽阔河流分成水道，较小的溪流蜿蜒穿过低地。高地和季节性潮湿的河岸均覆盖着茂密林木。莫茹河及其支流构成托坎廷斯河以东复杂景观的一部分，将森林覆盖的内陆与帕拉河口水域连接起来。

english: Saravan lies in eastern Iranian Baluchistan, in the drainage country of the Mashkid River and its tributaries. Mountain ranges separate its valleys from the Jaz Murian depression to the west, while the Mashkid runs towards the inland basin of Hamun-e Mashkel. Ancient sites and old forts are scattered through the district, including the fortress of Dezak near Saravan. The combination of irrigated settlements, dry riverbeds and rugged hills gives this part of the Baluch interior a character distinct from the coastal plains of Makran.
simp_chinese: 萨拉万位于伊朗俾路支斯坦东部，处在马什基德河及其支流的流域之中。山脉将这里的谷地与西面的贾兹穆里安洼地分隔开来，马什基德河则流向内陆的马什凯勒哈蒙盆地。古遗址和老堡垒散布各处，包括萨拉万附近的德扎克堡。灌溉聚落、干涸河床和崎岖丘陵共同构成俾路支内陆的景观，与马克兰海岸平原截然不同。

english: The Saraveka were an Indigenous people of Chiquitania, in the forest and savanna country of eastern Bolivia. Their language belonged to the Arawak family. Jesuit missionaries established the missions of Chiquitos from the late seventeenth century, bringing together people from different local societies. Saraveka descendants were among those who contributed to the Chiquitano people, whose history carries the imprint of this meeting of communities.
simp_chinese: 萨拉维卡人是玻利维亚东部奇基塔尼亚森林与稀树草原地带的原住民族，其语言属于阿拉瓦克语族。十七世纪末起，耶稣会士建立奇基托斯传教聚落，将不同地方社会的人们聚集在一起。萨拉维卡人的后裔参与形成了奇基塔诺人，其历史留下了这些社群相遇的印记。

english: Saraya lies on a granite massif whose streams feed the Falémé, in the gold country of Bambouk. The surrounding land was known as Dantila, remembered as a province of the Mali Empire and as the domain of the Danfakha chiefs. Local tradition tells that their ancestor was a great hunter who rid the country of a destructive buffalo. Gold from the wider Bambouk region traveled north across the Sahara and made its name known far beyond the river valleys where it was obtained.
simp_chinese: 萨拉亚坐落在一片花岗岩高地上，溪流从这里汇入法莱梅河，周围是班布克的产金地区。这片土地被称为丹蒂拉，人们记得它曾是马里帝国的一个省，也是丹法卡酋长的领地。当地传说讲述，他们的祖先是一位伟大的猎人，曾为这片土地除掉一头毁坏庄稼的恶水牛。班布克地区的黄金向北越过撒哈拉，使这里远近闻名。

english: Sarayan stands on the dry eastern side of the Iranian plateau, north of the older town of Tun. Its caravanserai, built in the Safavid period, formed part of a complex that included a market, a bathhouse and a cistern. Arranged around a courtyard with two iwans, the inn provided rooms for travellers and space for their animals, recalling the traffic that once passed through this desert town.
simp_chinese: 萨拉扬位于伊朗高原干旱的东部，在古城通的北方。这里的商队旅舍建于萨法维时期，与市场、浴室和蓄水池组成建筑群。旅舍围绕设有两座伊万厅的庭院修建，既有供旅客住宿的房间，也有容纳牲畜的空间，见证了往来这座沙漠城镇的商旅。

english:
Saray-Jük, “Little Sarai”, stood on the right bank of the Ural, then called the Yaik, some 50 km above the river's mouth on the Caspian. It lay on the northern road from the Volga to Khwarazm. Ibn Battuta crossed the river here in 1334 by ferry and compared the crossing to Baghdad. Excavations found ceramic water pipes and drains, potters' and metalworkers' workshops, and inscribed vessels that show an unusually developed town for the steppe. Nobles from all over the Horde came to hunt and fish in the surrounding country.

A later chronicle says the khans Jani Beg and Berdi Beg were enthroned and buried here. Timur destroyed the town in 1395. It was rebuilt in the 1430s–40s and from the 1490s was the only real city and the capital of the Nogai Horde, where Kasym Khan of the Kazakhs was also buried. In 1580 free Cossacks sacked and burned it, and the survivors left for Khiva.
simp_chinese:
萨莱楚克意为「小萨莱」，位于乌拉尔河右岸，当时称雅伊克河，距离河口入里海处约50公里。它处在从伏尔加河通往花剌子模的北路上。1334年伊本·白图泰乘渡船在此过河，说这一渡口让他想起巴格达。考古发现了陶制输水管和排水道、陶工与金属匠的作坊，以及刻有铭文的器皿，显示出一座在草原上异常发达的城镇。汗国各地的贵族都来这里周边狩猎、捕鱼。

后世的一部编年史说，札尼别汗与别尔迪别汗都在此登基并葬于此地。1395年帖木儿摧毁了这座城镇。它在1430至1440年代重建，自1490年代起成为诺盖汗国唯一像样的城市和都城，哈萨克汗国的卡西姆汗也葬在这里。1580年，自由哥萨克洗劫并焚毁了它，幸存者迁往希瓦。

english: Sarbaz gives its name to a river that cuts through the Makran mountains towards the Sea of Oman. The settlement is also known as Qaleh-ye Sarbaz, or the fort of Sarbaz, recalling the strongholds of local chiefs in Baluchistan. Along the long river gorge, villages occupy pockets of ground between steep dry hills. Archaeological remains beside the river reveal settlement in the third millennium BCE and connections with other lands of southeastern Iran and the coast.
simp_chinese: 萨尔巴兹得名于流经此地的河流；萨尔巴兹河穿越马克兰山脉，流向阿曼海。聚落又称萨尔巴兹堡，让人想起俾路支斯坦地方首领的据点。漫长河谷中，村庄散布在干旱陡峭山坡之间的土地上。河畔考古遗存显示，公元前三千纪已有居民在此定居，并与伊朗东南部其他地区和海岸有所联系。

english: Sarbisheh lies in the dry uplands of southern Khorasan, between the country of Birjand and the approaches to Sistan. Old settlements and fortified sites dot the surrounding district, a meeting place of the historical regions of Khorasan and Sistan. The sparse vegetation and broad expanses of bare ground contrast with the cultivated land around villages, where access to water made settlement possible.
simp_chinese: 萨尔比谢位于南呼罗珊的干燥高地，介于比尔詹德地区与通往锡斯坦的道路之间。周围散布着古老聚落和设防遗址，这里也是呼罗珊与锡斯坦两个历史地区的交会地带。稀疏植被和广阔荒地与村庄附近的耕地形成对比；水源使这些聚落得以存在。
